## Job description

Progressive legal careers

Peerpoint is A&O Shearman's global platform for self-directed consultant lawyers who want to access the best work, clients, resources and bespoke support, whilst undertaking assignments of typically six months or more, either within A&O Shearman practice groups or directly with clients. To find out more, please visit.

Join us

We are currently looking for lawyers with 8+ years' top-tier post-qualification experience in derivatives (including structured products) and structured finance.

Examples of recent opportunities

* A senior equity derivatives lawyer supporting a bank's strategic equity business, with a focus on quantitative investment strategies (QIS).
* Derivatives lawyer with experience of secured loan linked hedging or structured finance hedging (e.g. securitisation swaps) to support a bank's derivatives and securities lending team.
* Structured products lawyer supporting a bank's structured securities business in Europe on a cross-asset basis (equity, credit, fixed income and FX), including negotiating distribution agreements, supporting the onboarding of distributors, contributing to product governance fora, reviewing and preparing trade documentation and templates, supporting on automation initiatives and providing legal advice on new structured products and cross-border issues.
* Supporting the structured credit and credit derivatives team of an investment bank, with a remit covering credit derivatives, OTC, repacks and CLOs, in a transaction management role.
* Structured products lawyer within a bank advising on, reviewing, negotiating and settling all documentation relating to finance linked hedges and deal contingent hedging transactions, performing due diligence on underlying facility agreements, inter-creditor and security agreements and advising in respect of structured financing arrangements.
* Derivatives lawyer supporting a financial group's capital markets business, with responsibilities including negotiating documents that govern OTC derivatives (including ISDAs, CSAs, CDEAs, GMRAs, GMSLAs), working on live transactional legal work to negotiate derivatives, collateral and financing documents in relation to bond issuances including structured bonds, and acting as a subject matter expert on relevant laws, regulations and policies, in particular in the EMEA derivatives space.


Our criteria

Successful applicants will:

* Have at least eight years' post-qualification experience in derivatives and structured finance, including a minimum of two years' post-qualification experience at a law firm ranked as top tier for derivatives and structured finance;
* Ideally have recent in-house legal experience at a leading financial services institution (directly or as a secondee);
* Have a desire to take ownership of their career and be responsible for their own professional development and network, proactively making use of any support and resources available;
* Have researched the personal and financial factors that you need to consider when commencing a career as a legal consultant and be comfortable with the ways in which it differs from permanent employment;
* Be committed to building a positive and productive relationship with Peerpoint, including having a transparent, open and responsive style of communication;
* Have a consultant mindset, including a highly professional, flexible and adaptable outlook and approach;
* Have an ability to make effective transitions into new environments and be motivated to deliver an excellent standard of service to each client;
* Have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with an ability to professionally deal with stakeholders at all levels, building strong relationships internally and externally;
* Be resilient, autonomous and highly credible, with exemplary commercial/business acumen and client service ethic;
* Have proven project management skills; and
* Have a practising certificate (or equivalent) which entitles them to practise as a lawyer in the UK.


Note: Due to the nature of the relationship between Peerpoint and our legal consultants, we are not able to sponsor visas. Applicants are therefore required to have a right to reside and work in the UK. As a result of the high volume of applications we receive, it is our policy not to provide individual feedback at the application stage.



A career with Peerpoint is unmatched in the market. Over the last decade, we've helped lead the transformation of legal consulting as a truly credible option alongside private practice and in-house legal careers. We also have one of the most supportive offerings around, all with the full backing of A&O Shearman.

Empowering your development - you'll be fully supported by our experienced team and will have access to A&O Shearman's training, development and networking events, including opportunities to grow your skillset with A&O Shearman's Advanced Delivery & Solutions businesses. On assignment, you'll have access to an A&O Shearman partner and professional support lawyers as well as extensive knowledge resources.

Variety you control - steer your legal career in whichever direction you choose. Whether you're looking for more control, choice or variety, as a Peerpoint consultant you'll have the pick of the best challenges from across a range of sectors.

Let your priorities lead - it's never been more important to find the right balance. That could mean more flexibility over the time you spend between your personal and professional life, whether that's to pursue a passion, spend time with family or take breaks to travel the world.

Futureproof your career - if you need coaching or mentoring, our team can guide you on the range of diverse paths to help you grow your experience. By understanding your needs and supporting you at every step, we'll help you succeed so you can flourish both today and tomorrow.

Lead firmware engineering and delivery for a new connected-appliance platform, from architecture and hardware integration through validation and production release. The role combines technical leadership with line management of one Firmware Developer. You will help make the platform reliable, testable and ready for production, integrating device behavior with connectivity and cloud services.

* Define and evolve firmware architecture for the device platform, working within agreed domain standards.
* Develop and review embedded C++ software for the ESP32-C5 platform, keeping hardware access, connectivity, and product behavior in clear modules.
* Guide implementation of the platform’s event-driven messaging and typed contracts so components can integrate without unnecessary coupling.
* Integrate firmware with sensors, actuators, cooling and keg-management functions, the user interface, diagnostics and monitoring.
* Work with the hardware abstraction layers to keep device-specific access separate from product logic and support consistent testing.
* Integrate Wi-Fi, BLE provisioning and cloud services, including telemetry, device commands and reported or desired state.
* Support secure device operation and update flows, including provisioning, TLS and over-the-air updates.
* Lead firmware delivery from design and hardware bring-up through integration, validation, field testing and production release.
* Debug behaviour across firmware, hardware, connectivity and cloud interfaces; drive defects through to resolution and use field evidence to improve the platform.
* Support applicable regulatory and certification work, working with hardware, quality and programme teams on firmware evidence and fixes.
* Coordinate firmware work with product, hardware, cloud and mobile teams, external R&D partners and contractors.
* Line manage and mentor the Firmware Developer, setting clear expectations for engineering quality and delivery.
* Establish practical coding, testing, review, and release practices that make firmware maintainable and reduce defects reaching production.

* Proven ability to bring up, debug, and test firmware on physical devices.
* Experience with connected products, networking protocols, and device-to-cloud integration.
* Ability to design modular software and communicate system-level technical trade-offs.
* Experience leading technical delivery, mentoring engineers and coordinating cross-functional teams and external partners.
* Strong focus on testing, release discipline, risk management, and continuous engineering improvement.
* Confident use of AI-assisted development tools, with accountability for code quality, correctness, security, and production readiness.
* Nice to have: ESP32/Espressif IDF, modern C++23, Azure IoT/AWS IoT, BLE provisioning, secure boot, flash encryption, OTA updates and device certification.
* Success measures: Reliable firmware delivery aligned with milestones, maintainable interfaces, robust connectivity, early defect resolution and readiness for certification and production.

**Help safeguard the future of Dacorum’s heritage**

Do you have a passion for museum collections, a keen eye for detail and the expertise to bring clarity to complex historic records? Dacorum Heritage is looking for an experienced freelance collections documentation consultant to help strengthen the records behind one of Hertfordshire’s most fascinating local history collections.

## About the opportunity

As the Accredited Museum for the borough of Dacorum, we care for more than 132,000 catalogued artefacts spanning approximately 6,000 years of local history, from the Neolithic period to the present day. Our collections tell the stories of the people, places and communities that have shaped the borough.

Our collections are held at our dedicated Museum Store in Berkhamsted and include objects owned by Dacorum Heritage, Dacorum Borough Council and seven local history organisations.

We are undertaking an important review of our historic documentation to clarify ownership, resolve discrepancies and ensure our records are accurate, consistent and fit for the future. With plans for a new venue and wider changes in local government on the horizon, this is a timely opportunity to make a real and lasting difference to the stewardship of Dacorum’s heritage.

## What will you do?

Working closely with our small, dedicated museum team, you will review historic paper entry forms alongside records held in our MODES collections management system. Your work will help us to:

* Clarify the ownership and collecting status of objects across our collections.
* Investigate discrepancies in historic documentation and identify records requiring further clarification.
* Create up-to-date inventories for our local history organisation partners.
* Improve the accuracy, consistency and reliability of our collections information.
* Produce clear reports to support future collections management and planning.

## Who are we looking for?

We are seeking someone with experience in museum documentation, collections management and historic records. You will bring a methodical, analytical approach, confidence using collections management systems and the ability to investigate complex records with care.

You will also be a clear communicator, able to manage queries sensitively and work constructively with local history organisations. The role requires initiative, flexibility and the confidence to work independently while collaborating with a small, part-time museum team.

Above all, you will understand the importance of accurate documentation in protecting collections, supporting research and ensuring that local heritage remains accessible and well cared for.

## How to apply

Click here for more details  

If you have the skills and experience to help us strengthen the foundations of our collections management, we would love to hear from you.

Please email your CV and covering letter to Melissa Linsey, Museum Manager, at melissalinsey@dacorumheritage.org.uk, using the subject line Application for Document Review Consultant.

Your covering letter should outline your relevant experience, proposed approach to reviewing paper records and MODES data, methods for managing accuracy and ownership queries, approach to communication with local history organisations, availability during the project period and suitability for the role.

**Deadline:** Sunday 8 November 2026.

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

## About the Role

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Platform team, you will own the technical direction of Alpaca's streaming platform - our Redpanda-based event backbone and the user-facing streaming infrastructure. Platform also owns Authentication, Developer Experience and QA, and AI-Native Engineering. Streaming is roughly two-thirds of the job and where we expect you to become the deepest engineer in the company; across the other three you review the designs, hold an informed opinion, and lead the work where they meet streaming.

This is a Staff role, so we are hiring for direction as much as delivery - the engineer who decides what the streaming platform looks like in two years, writes the RFC that gets three teams to agree, and then builds the hard part. We own client-facing and internal services, maintain shared libraries nearly every team depends on, and manage our own deployments. Most of our time goes into Go, but we also write Helm charts, dig through logs and metrics, and get pulled into a wide variety of problems.

#### Things You Get To Do

* Own the architecture of our event streaming platform end to end - Redpanda, the UTS ecosystem, client libraries and user-facing streaming - and set its two-to-three-year direction
* Lead the shift from batch to event-driven across Alpaca's systems, working with the teams who own them rather than around them
* Design user-facing streaming at scale: connection fan-out, slow consumers, backpressure, ordering and delivery guarantees, and the failure modes that only show up on a volatile market day
* Set the standards for event-driven design - schema evolution, topic ownership, replay, idempotency - and own the shared libraries other teams build against, including the cost of versioning and deprecation

* Establish delivery frameworks and standards to ensure consistency, quality and speed of delivery.

* Create clear delivery timelines, monitor progress, and address risks or delays proactively.

* Document and present the value of each data product delivered to the business.

* Lead the transition from legacy systems (e.g., Cognos, Oracle, Qlik) to modern cloud-based platforms (Azure, Databricks and Power BI), including decommissioning plans and managing business continuity throughout.

* Design and execute innovative sales strategies tailored to professional services procurement cycles, vendor risk assessment, and budgeting processes to meet and exceed revenue quotas. Analyse professional services market landscapes, trends, and dynamics to translate high-level plans into targeted sales activities and campaigns
* Spearhead market expansion by identifying new use cases within client delivery teams, creative and strategy functions, research and knowledge management, and business development. Collaborate cross-functionally to differentiate our offerings for professional services applications
* Navigate complex professional services stakeholder ecosystems including executives, partners and practice leaders, IT departments, risk and compliance functions, and procurement offices to build consensus
* Inform product roadmaps and features by gathering feedback from users and conveying professional services market needs. Provide insights that strengthen our value proposition for professional services
* Continuously refine the professional services sales methodology by incorporating learnings into playbooks, templates, and best practices. Identify process improvements that optimise sales productivity and consistency

## You may be a good fit if you have:

* 8+ years of B2B Enterprise sales experience in SaaS, API solutions, or emerging technologies
* A track record of managing complex sales cycles within professional services firms and securing strategic deals by understanding both technical requirements and professional services use cases
* Demonstrated ability to navigate professional services organisational structures and procurement processes, building consensus among diverse stakeholders including executives, partners and practice leaders, and IT departments
* Extensive experience negotiating complex agreements within professional services procurement frameworks, vendor risk and third-party assurance policies
* Proven experience exceeding revenue targets by effectively managing an evolving pipeline and sales process
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to present confidently to various professional services audiences, from practice leads and delivery teams to senior partners
* Deep understanding of professional services buying cycles, decision-making processes, and key pain points, including the client confidentiality and regulatory obligations firms operate within
* A strategic, analytical approach to assessing the professional services market combined with creative, tactical execution to capture opportunities
* A passion for and/or experience with advanced AI systems and their applications. You feel strongly about ensuring frontier AI systems are developed safely and ethically for professional services use

Annual Salary:

£280,000 - £330,000 GBP

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:**A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Serás responsable de gestionar y recuperar los pagos de fellows que cursaron nuestro entrenamiento y cuya obligación de pago se ha activado conforme a las condiciones de su contrato.

* Dar seguimiento a los acuerdos hasta confirmar el ingreso y la correcta aplicación de los pagos.
* Registrar en el CRM las gestiones, respuestas, objeciones, compromisos, comprobantes y próximos pasos.
* Coordinar con Finanzas, Operaciones, el equipo de acompañamiento a fellows y asesoría legal para resolver casos.
* Preparar expedientes completos para los casos que requieran revisión o escalamiento legal.
* Proponer mejoras en mensajes, procesos, segmentación y estrategias de recuperación.

**Lo que buscamos**

* Al menos **3 años de experiencia en cobranza, recuperación de cartera o negociación de pagos**, con participación directa en casos de alta resistencia.
* Experiencia gestionando cartera de personas físicas en Argentina y el resto de LATAM, y conocimiento de los hábitos de comunicación y negociación del mercado local.
* Resultados comprobables en recuperación de pagos, cumplimiento de metas y seguimiento de acuerdos.
* Experiencia leyendo contratos y explicando obligaciones, condiciones de pago y cláusulas relevantes de forma clara.
* Capacidad para manejar objeciones, desescalar conflictos y sostener conversaciones difíciles con profesionalismo.

* Manejo de CRM, Excel o Google Sheets y herramientas de comunicación digital.
* Organización y autonomía para gestionar una cartera de manera remota.
* Criterio para reconocer cuándo un caso requiere revisión legal y evitar comprometer condiciones fuera de su autorización.
* Disponibilidad para coordinar contactos en los usos horarios de Argentina y otros países de LATAM.

* Experiencia en fintech, créditos personales, financiamiento educativo, edtech, bootcamps, suscripciones o servicios con pagos diferidos.
* Experiencia con esquemas de pago vinculados a contratación laboral o mejora de ingresos.
* Es un plus contar experiencia trabajando con despachos o equipos legales.
* Formación en Derecho, Administración, Contabilidad, Finanzas o carreras afines.

* Monto efectivamente recuperado frente a la meta asignada.
* Tasa de recuperación sobre la cartera gestionable.
* Porcentaje de contacto efectivo con los fellows.
* Tiempo de recuperación y evolución de saldos vencidos.

* Mantener trazabilidad completa de las gestiones y acuerdos.
* Mostrar resultados de recuperación frente a las metas definidas.
* Identificar las principales objeciones y proponer mejoras concretas al proceso.

* Trabajo 100% remoto desde LATAM, preferentemente Argentina.
* Participación en una compañía de educación en inteligencia artificial con alcance regional.
* Oportunidad de contribuir a la mejora del proceso de cobranza y recuperación.

**Aon UK Industrial Placement Recruitment: What to Expect**

We know applying for your first industrial placement role can be exciting, and sometimes a little daunting. At Aon, we’re committed to making our recruitment process as transparent and supportive as possible. Here’s how our selection journey works, and what you can expect at each stage:

1. **Application Review**

* We process applications on a rolling basis, moving candidates forward as they complete each stage.
* Every application is carefully reviewed by our team (not by AI).
* Due to the high volume of interest, this stage can take up to two weeks.
* Please note: We do not review CVs or cover letters at this point.

**2. Online Assessment**

* We understand you want to put your best foot forward, allowing you 5 calendar days to complete the online assessment.
* If you need more time, just let us know as extensions are available.

**3. Video Interview**

* Preparation matters, so you’ll have up to 10 days (240 hours) from receiving your invitation to record and submit your video interview.
* Rest assured: Every video interview is reviewed by a real member of our hiring team, not an AI system.
* You’ll typically hear back from us within 2-3 weeks after submitting your interview, though times may vary depending on how many applications we receive.

**4. Assessment Centres**

* Our assessment centres are held in person at the Aon site closest to the location you applied for.
* Please note: Due to the large number of applications, not every candidate who completes a video interview will be invited to an assessment centre.

* If selected, a notice period of 7-14 days will be provided to help you arrange any travel.
* We run a limited number of Assessment Centre so please make every effort to attend if invited.
* We reimburse reasonable travel costs (such as standard class train tickets). Flights and hotels are only covered if agreed in advance.

As an innovative global leader, we recognize and embrace the power of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help job seekers be more efficient in their recruitment processes. In fact, Aon is in the business of developing and implementing innovative AI tools that support both colleagues and clients, which you’ll use as an Aon colleague if you join our team.

AI can be a helpful tool for researching Aon, preparing for interviews or refining your CV, it should support, not replace, your own thinking, judgement, skills and experiences. Any application materials you submit should accurately reflect your achievements, capabilities and potential.

We ask that you refrain from using AI when completing assessments or during live or pre-recorded interview processes, which will often include an in-person interview where the technology will not be available to you. Additionally, virtual or in-person interviews should not be recorded or transcribed.

At Aon, we foster a culture of inclusiveness, fairness and transparency. We expect all candidates to embrace these principles in every interaction with us.

**Can I apply for more than one programme or role?**

We ask candidates to submit one Early Carers application per recruitment cycle. We encourage you to explore our opportunities carefully and apply for the programme or role that best matches your skills, passions, and professional aspirations. If you're unsure which programme is right for you, we recommend reviewing the programme information on our careers site or attending one of our events before applying.

Your work will directly shape how reliably and efficiently Apple delivers cloud inference at scale.
You'll join iCloud Platform Engineering team. We build the server stack behind Push Notifications, iMessage, FaceTime, iCloud, iCloud Private Relay and Private Cloud Compute. Our internet scale distributed systems deliver real-time experiences with very low latency and very high availability. You'll develop routing and scheduling strategies within this privacy model, working with inference and security teams to evaluate techniques such as cache aware request placement and prefill/decode disaggregation.

Full or Part Time | Permanent | Bristol

​

We are hiring our first Engineer to work on the machine learning model at the core of our biosensing platform. 

​

We are hiring an experienced Machine Learning Engineer to built, train, optimize and deploy our models reliably. Some experience and ability in Cloud Engineering and Software Engineering is desirable to architect and build our software stack from the ground up. This is a role, with real ownership. You will own the entire digital pipeline that turns raw data from our physical units into actionable, real-time alerts.

​

You'll be reporting to the CTO/Lead Engineer and working alongside a R&D Scientist building the sensor hardware. This is a fantastic opportunity for a commercially curious and self-motivated engineer who also wants to develop their knowledge of how an early stage startup works.

## The Role

## Working closely with our CTO and R&D Scientist you will:

* ## own the classification system at the heart of our platform
* ## convert raw spectral processing to actionable user alerts
* ## work with small, noisy datasets that are tightly coupled to the underlying physical instrumentation.

## 

## The Scope

Spectral signal processing

* Baseline correction, cosmic ray and noise filtering, normalisation, peak extraction and feature engineering on 1D spectra.
* Matrix-specific background models.

Classification and validation

* Build and train a classifier over a reference library containing both bacterial and chemical targets.
* Design validation. Classes are imbalanced and accuracy alone is not a sufficient metric.
* Define operational targets.
* Report per-class, with confusion matrices and ROC curves.
* Handle systematic differences in signal quality between classes.

Data strategy

* Establish the ground-truth and collection requirements to shape the laboratory work.
* Contribute to the product roadmap, including how the library scales and how models reach deployed units.

The Stack

* Language: Python, end to end.
* Signal processing and ML: NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch.
* Backend and interface: FastAPI, Flask or a comparable lightweight framework.
* Cloud: Standard AWS, GCP or Azure SDKs. Nothing exotic.

You are welcome to propose alternatives with a good technical argument behind them.

## Essential Requirements

* Experience: 2+ years of applied machine learning engineering experience, ideally with a background in Bioinformatics, Chemometrics or where software interacts with physical sensors.
* Familiarity with 1D signal or spectra data processing or a willingness to learn.
* Rigour when it comes to validation.

## Bonus if you’re familiar with

* Deploying models behind an API in a cloud environment with latency constraints.
* Working with data coming off physical instruments, and the messiness that entails.
* Chemometrics, bioinformatics or microbiology exposure.

## Practical details ​

* Salary range £45-60,000 FTE depending on experience and equity package.
* We are open to discussion with regards to a remuneration combining equity and salary.
* Reports to: CTO
* Location: Bristol, access to lab facilities is required. We are open to discussion regarding hybrid and remote working but some visits to the team in Bristol will be required
* Permanent contract

#### **Join Axon and be a Force for Good.**

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

## **Your Impact**

We are seeking an International Accounting Senior Manager to join our growing international finance team and take ownership of the accuracy, timeliness and control of financial reporting across Axon's 20+ international entities. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. You will lead through technical expertise, judgement and influence, directing the work of outsourced statutory preparers and partnering with colleagues in corporate (US) accounting, tax, treasury, revenue and internal audit.

You will own the international period-end close and the overall plan for local audits and statutory filings, act as a technical authority on IFRS and US GAAP, serve as the lead contact for local auditors and filings, lead entity set-ups, and drive the improvement and automation of international accounting processes. The role suits an experienced, fully qualified accountant who is comfortable making and defending accounting judgements, working across time zones, and raising the standard of the team around them.

**Location:** London or Daventry office, UK

**Reports to:** Director of Accounting, International

**Level:** L9

**Direct reports:** None

## **What You'll Do**

### **Close and reporting ownership**

* Own the monthly, quarterly and annual close across all international entities (20+), from calendar and deadline management through to review and sign-off, ensuring accurate and timely reporting to corporate (US) accounting
* Review journal entries, account reconciliations, intercompany balances and financial schedules prepared by others, and confirm compliance with IFRS, US GAAP and Axon accounting policies
* Lead balance sheet and P&L variance analysis, and present clear explanations of key movements to the Director of Accounting, International and wider finance leadership
* Oversee cash, intercompany, foreign currency translation and remeasurement processes for the international entities

### **Technical accounting**

* Act as the technical accounting lead for the international entities: research, conclude and document positions on non-routine transactions, and prepare technical memos for auditors and internal stakeholders
* Apply IFRS and US GAAP, with in-depth IFRS expertise and good working knowledge of US GAAP, particularly revenue recognition (ASC 606 and IFRS 15) and leases (ASC 842 and IFRS 16)
* Identify, quantify and communicate differences between local GAAP, IFRS and US GAAP, and make sure reporting is reconciled between them
* Monitor new accounting standards and assess their impact on the international entities

### **Statutory reporting and audit**

* Set and own the overall plan for statutory reporting, local audits and filings across the international entities, including management of the outsourced statutory preparers on scope, timelines and the quality of the financial statements
* Act as lead contact for local statutory auditors and filings, and work with the Director and the global auditors on the global audit: agree audit plans and PBC lists, manage queries, and resolve or escalate audit issues
* Defend Axon's accounting positions with auditors where appropriate, and agree adjustments where they are warranted
* Make sure local statutory filing deadlines are met, working with tax and legal

### **Entity set-ups and controls**

* Lead the accounting aspects of entity set-ups, expansion, acquisitions and system implementations
* Develop cross functional relationships with Tax, FP&A, Legal, IT, Operations, HR and Sales supporting PMO activities as part of legal entity expansion
* Support the internal controls over financial reporting for the international processes, including control design, evidence and remediation of deficiencies, working with internal audit
* Maintain accounting policies, procedures and process documentation for the international entities

### **Process improvement and projects**

* Identify, design and deliver process improvements and automation, including AI-enabled approaches, in the international accounting function
* Improve the use of Microsoft D365, OneStream and Blackline across the international entities

### **Partnership and influence**

* Partner with corporate (US) accounting, tax, treasury, revenue, FP&A and internal audit to make sure international requirements are understood and met
* Review the work of, and provide guidance and mentoring to junior members of the accounting team, without formal line management responsibility
* Special projects and ad-hoc requests as assigned

## **What You Bring**

* Bachelor's or higher degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field
* Fully qualified ACA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent (Big 4 training preferred) with 10+ years of post-qualified experience, gained either (i) in a US GAAP listed technology company with international operations, or (ii) in Big 4 practice at senior manager level or above, with strong IFRS and US GAAP exposure
* In-depth technical knowledge of IFRS and good working knowledge of US GAAP, including revenue and leases, and the ability to research and conclude on complex or non-routine transactions
* Proven ownership of the close across multiple international entities in a multi-currency environment
* Experience of statutory reporting and audits across more than one jurisdiction, of working with both global and local auditors, and of supporting entity set-ups
* Track record of influencing and delivering results through others without direct authority, including managing third-party service providers
* Track record of improving processes and delivering automation, including the use of AI tools
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex accounting matters clearly to finance leaders and non-finance colleagues
* Superb attention to detail, strong planning and organisation skills, and the ability to prioritise and deliver in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
* Experience working in a SOX-compliant environment is a plus
* Experience with Microsoft D365 or OneStream is preferred
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
* Ability to work autonomously as well as in a team setting across time zones

**A&C Principal Engineer – New Product Introduction**

**Location:**UK, Poland, Brazil

**Partner with the best**

Baker Hughes is a global energy technology company serving energy and industrial customers in more than 120 countries. Built on over a century of innovation, the company provides advanced products, services, and digital solutions that support efficient, safe, and lower‐carbon energy operations. Its portfolio spans oilfield services and equipment, turbomachinery, industrial technologies, and emerging energy transition solutions such as hydrogen, carbon capture, and emissions management. Baker Hughes continues to help customers meet the world’s evolving energy needs through technology leadership, operational excellence, and a strong commitment to sustainability.

**Fuel your passion**

The A&C Principal Engineer – New Product Introduction is a Technical Title Holder (TTH) within the Technical Oversight pathway, accountable for providing recognised technical expertise, independent assurance and continuity of technical authority across the full product lifecycle. Although primarily aligned to NPI, the role shall work as an integrated partner with Execution Product Engineering, Project Delivery, Services, Manufacturing, Quality and other relevant TTHs so that field experience, project learning, product performance and lifecycle constraints inform new-product decisions, and mature NPI solutions are transferred into execution and lifecycle support with clear ownership, evidence and residual risk.

As an A&C Principal Engineer, you will be responsible for:

* Operating as subject matter expert (SME) for A&C New Product Introduction (NPI), ensuring adherence to BH-QUA-38 stage gates.
* Chairing technical reviews, ensuring completeness and adherence to process (ENGWW 18.07, SSDS-ENG-9.09, QW-PCS-NAI-ENG-502, QW-PCS-NAI-ENG-503) for new product introductions.
* Consolidating and approving Technology Readiness Level (TRL) assessments for new product introductions.
* Preparing Technical Maturity Assessments (TMAs) for new product development to support early customer engagement, front-end development, and tendering activities.
* Governing technical maturity gap closure activities with product engineering resources.
* Leading technology acceptance activities with customers for new product introductions.
* Governing intellectual property assessments for new product introductions and new technology patents.
* Governing product safety assessments for new product introductions.
* Approving technical risks associated with new product introductions to support future risk management during project execution and delivery.
* Establishing and maintaining a structured technical partnership between NPI and Execution A&C teams, including Product Engineering, Project Execution, and Services, to ensure consistent technical decisions, clear interfaces, common design practices, and seamless handover of NPI outputs into customer projects and lifecycle support.
* Creating a two-way lifecycle feedback loop between NPI and Execution engineering communities to ensure project execution experience, manufacturing feedback, non-conformances, root-cause investigations, field performance, obsolescence, serviceability, and lessons learned are incorporated into future product requirements, architectures, qualification plans, design practices, and product roadmaps.
* Agreeing with relevant Execution-based TTHs on technical ownership, review, and approval responsibilities at each lifecycle transition, including acceptance criteria for NPI release, deployment, product support, and subsequent product changes, while ensuring assumptions, deviations, and residual risks are visible and assigned to accountable owners.
* Working jointly with discipline and product TTHs across NPI and Execution organizations to apply consistent technical governance, share specialist knowledge, resolve cross-functional technical challenges, and provide coherent technical direction to engineering teams, customers, and business stakeholders.
* Supporting the wider A&C technical community by mentoring engineers across both NPI and Execution teams, maintaining knowledge-sharing mechanisms, and promoting cross-functional learning, common standards, and best practices.
* Collaborating closely with manufacturing to ensure new product manufacturability.
* Interfacing directly with customers and supporting Product Management by providing technical guidance, gathering feedback, clarifying requirements, and supporting the successful deployment of new product solutions.
* Collaborating with Engineering and Manufacturing teams to ensure the effective development, validation, and execution of test and qualification procedures that meet technical and programme requirements.
* Ensuring all NPI activities comply with engineering governance, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Providing expert guidance on product design, validation, qualification, and industrialization.
* Reviewing and supporting the preparation of technical documentation, including specifications, test plans, verification reports, and configuration deliverables.
* Contributing technical insights to product roadmaps, feasibility assessments, and technology development discussions.
* Mentoring engineering teams and promoting best practices, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement in engineering and NPI processes.
* Ensuring harmonisation across current and future NPI programmes.

  

**To be successful in this role you will:**

* Have a Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronic, Automation, Control Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Have significant experience in Automation & Control Engineering, ideally within New Product Introduction (NPI), product development, or industrial technology environments.
* Demonstrate strong technical leadership and the ability to influence engineering decisions across multidisciplinary teams.
* Possess experience in the design, development, and implementation of industrial control systems and automation solutions.
* Have a solid understanding of engineering standards, risk management, and product lifecycle development processes.
* Be an effective communicator with strong problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
* Be able to work collaboratively within global, cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Demonstrate a commitment to safety, quality, compliance, and continuous improvement.

**Work in a way that works for you**

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and perform at their best may vary. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working pattern:

* Hybrid working arrangement, combining office-based and remote working where business needs allow.
* Occasional travel to Baker Hughes facilities, customer sites, and suppliers as required.

**Working with us**

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. We invest in the health and wellbeing of our workforce, develop talent at all levels, and foster an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

**Join Us**

# Senior Engineer - Process

London; Manchester; Motherwell

At BakerHicks, our Process Engineering team works collaboratively to solve complex challenges across a diverse range of sectors, including pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, life sciences, chemicals, nuclear, manufacturing, food & drink, defence, and power.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Process Engineer who enjoys working as part of a multidisciplinary team, applying technical expertise to deliver practical engineering solutions, and supporting successful project outcomes. You'll join a supportive environment where collaboration, innovation, and professional development are highly valued.

This role offers the opportunity to work across the full project lifecycle, from concept and feasibility studies through to detailed design, procurement support, commissioning, and EPCM delivery. You'll contribute to a variety of technically challenging projects while developing strong client relationships and working alongside talented engineers and designers across the business.

#### What You'll Be Doing

As a Senior Process Engineer, you will:

* Deliver process engineering solutions across the full project lifecycle, from concept and feasibility through to detailed design and project delivery.
* Work within multidisciplinary project teams to develop innovative and practical engineering solutions.
* Lead the process engineering discipline on smaller projects and support senior engineers on larger programmes.
* Develop and review Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs) and Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs).
* Undertake heat and mass balance calculations.
* Produce process datasheets, equipment specifications, schedules, and technical documentation.
* Perform equipment sizing calculations, pressure drop calculations, and pump sizing activities.
* Participate in HAZOP studies and other process safety and risk assessment activities.
* Develop utility system specifications, designs, and capacity assessments.
* Obtain equipment quotations and undertake Technical Bid Analysis reviews.
* Manage equipment packages and liaise with vendors, including reviewing vendor documentation and technical submissions.
* Review piping design deliverables, including isometric drawings and plant layouts.
* Support plant layout development and design coordination activities.
* Build strong working relationships with clients and key project stakeholders.
* Carry out site visits, surveys, and P&ID walk-downs where required.
* Deliver quality engineering solutions in line with project schedules, budgets, and client expectations.

#### What We're Looking For

We're interested in speaking with engineers who combine strong technical capability with a collaborative approach and a passion for delivering high-quality engineering solutions.

#### What You'll Bring

* Degree in Chemical Engineering or a related discipline from a recognised university.
* Minimum of 5 years' experience within one or more relevant industrial sectors.
* Experience within one or more of the following sectors:
  + Chemicals
  + Pharmaceuticals
  + Biotechnology
  + Nuclear
  + Manufacturing
* Strong process engineering fundamentals and experience in the design of process plants.
* Experience producing process engineering calculations, specifications, and technical documentation.
* Experience working within multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high technical standards.

#### Why BakerHicks?

At BakerHicks, we recognise that great engineering comes from diverse perspectives and collaborative working. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels supported, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You'll have access to:

* Flexible and hybrid working options.
* Opportunities to work on exciting and varied projects across multiple industries.
* Industry-leading technical expertise and multidisciplinary collaboration.
* Ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities.
* A supportive and inclusive working environment.
* The opportunity to work on projects that make a meaningful impact across highly regulated and technically challenging sectors.

Many of the positions within our company are subject to security clearance or security assurance levels. 

The successful candidate must be able to obtain and maintain the appropriate level of security clearance or assurance level for this role, in line with client and sector requirements.

In some cases, additional nationality or residency criteria may also apply due to specific client or national security obligations.

 

Further information on National security clearance levels can be found on the UK Government website: (National security vetting: clearance levels - GOV.UK) 

**About BakerHicks**

We’ve been innovating in design, engineering and project delivery since 1957 and operate from 14 locations for a truly European reach. For more about our company story, see: About | BakerHicks.

BakerHicks. A Morgan Sindall Group company.

**Benefits**

Whatever your discipline, you’ll be alongside some of the most talented people in the industry. Our network of offices are appealing, friendly and comfortable spaces, easily accessible by car or public transport. And our salary and benefits packages are some of the best in the industry.

What you get will depend on what you do, with individual performance-related rewards also on offer in addition to:

* Company car or cash allowance
* Up to 6% matched contributory pension plan
* Life assurance scheme
* 25 days annual leave plus ability to buy additional leave
* Discount scheme (including gym membership, mobile phones etc)
* Flexible/hybrid working
* Family friendly policies
* Employee assistance
* Professional development

BakerHicks is an equal opportunity employer. We care about creating an inclusive atmosphere and are committed to promoting diversity and inclusion throughout.

The Bank of England’s Fintech Hub is looking for a Senior Fintech Analyst with technical expertise in AI and/or quantum computing to be based in our Leeds office. You will examine how these technologies work in practice, assess their implications for firms and the wider financial system, and turn complex technical evidence into clear advice for senior decision makers.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, finance and public policy, contributing to decisions with economy-wide significance.

**The Payments Innovation and Fintech Directorate (PFID)**

We lead high profile projects shaping the future of UK payments, including next-generation infrastructure, wholesale payments innovation and the digital pound. We also coordinate the Bank’s wider innovation and technology policy, working across teams to influence areas of growing Fintech importance.

PIFD brings together five specialist divisions:

* Fintech Hub (where this role sits)
* Digital Pound and Retail Payments Design
* Policy & International Strategy
* Wholesale Payments Innovation
* Payments Innovation Technology

Together, we aim to build a world‐class UK payments ecosystem and shape policy, product design and innovation across the sector.

**Fintech Hub**

The Fintech Hub sits within the Payments Innovation and Fintech Directorate and is the Bank’s centre of expertise on fintech and tech innovation. We lead strategic analysis on how innovation may support, or challenge, the Bank’s mission.

The Fintech Hub provides the analytical foundation and cross-cutting expertise needed to assess the impact of technology on finance. We look across the overall landscape, rather than at individual elements in isolation, to form judgements on emerging opportunities and risks and supporting the Bank’s development of coherent and comprehensive narrative on these developments.

Our current priorities include artificial intelligence, quantum computing and distributed ledger technology. We also monitor emerging technologies that could materially change financial services. This is a great opportunity to help shape the Bank’s approach to fast-moving innovation in an area of growing strategic importance.

**Job Description**

This permanent Senior Fintech Analyst role is in Bank’s Fintech Hub. We are a small team that acts as the Bank’s centre of expertise on fintech, guiding our exploration on how innovation and technology might support or challenge our mission. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. It would suit someone who has developed credible technical expertise through industry, research, academia, government or another applied setting, and now wants to use that expertise to inform public policy. You will work flexibly within a small, inclusive and collaborative team where people can learn quickly, test ideas and contribute to high-impact work. You will have the opportunity to apply technical expertise to questions that individual firms cannot answer alone: how emerging technologies could affect the resilience of financial institutions, the functioning of markets and payments, and the stability of the financial system as a whole.

The role will focus on advanced technologies, with a particular emphasis on artificial intelligence and/or quantum computing. We are looking for someone with proven technical knowledge in at least one of these areas who can apply that expertise to policy relevant questions and assess the implications for the financial system and the Bank’s objectives. We expect candidates to bring depth in at least one of Artificial Intelligence or quantum computing. You will not be expected to be an expert in both on joining, but you should be interested in broadening your knowledge and contributing across the Fintech Hub’s wider portfolio over time.

The successful candidate will apply and deepen their existing technical knowledge to strengthen the Bank’s understanding of how these technologies work in practice. They will engage directly with technical material such as system architectures, research papers, protocols and design documentation assessing the evidence, assumptions, limitations and practical significance of new developments. They will translate complex technical developments into clear, structured analysis for senior and non-technical audiences, supporting decision-making across policy, supervision, and financial stability work.

The role offers a unique opportunity to shape how the Bank monitors and responds to fast-moving technological change. This includes building market intelligence through internal and external networks, supporting cross-authority engagement, and leading cutting-edge analysis for high profile committees such as the FPC.

**Role Requirements**

We are recruiting one Senior Fintech Analyst role. The role sits in the Fintech Hub and focuses on how advanced technologies, particularly artificial intelligence and/or quantum computing, are evolving and what that means for the financial system and the Bank’s objectives.

You will operate as a senior fintech analyst, bringing proven technical knowledge of AI and/or quantum computing and applying it to questions relevant to the Bank’s mission. You will form clear judgements about how these technologies work in practice, the opportunities and risks they may create, and their implications for the resilience of firms and the wider financial system. You will not need to be a specialist in every aspect of both technologies, but you will need the curiosity, judgement and credibility to get up to speed quickly and explain why developments matter.

The role requires engaging directly with technical material (e.g. system architectures, research papers, protocol design). You will use this evidence to assess technological capabilities and limitations, challenge claims where appropriate and identify implications for policy, supervision, financial stability, monetary policy. This is not primarily a software-engineering or laboratory-research role. You will need sufficient technical depth to interrogate research, architectures, system designs and claims made by experts, and to form independent judgements about their practical significance.

## Job description

Better Collective is looking for an experienced **CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager** to establish and lead a group-wide approach to customer relationship management across our portfolio of global sports media brands.

This is a senior role combining **CRM strategy, customer lifecycle management, technology, data, commercial thinking and operational leadership**.

The successful candidate will move CRM beyond campaign execution and develop it as a strategic capability that helps Better Collective build deeper, more valuable relationships with its audiences.

Working across Product, Audience, Data, Commercial, Editorial, Technology and local brand teams, the CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager will create the frameworks, programmes and operating model required to turn first- and zero-party audience data into personalised customer experiences and measurable business value.

#### **The Opportunity**

Better Collective reaches millions of sports fans across a diverse portfolio of digital brands.

The next stage of our audience strategy is to develop stronger direct relationships with those users — moving from **anonymous audiences → known users → understood customers → engaged and valuable relationships**.

CRM will be central to that transformation.

The CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager will establish the strategy, capabilities and standards that allow Better Collective brands to acquire, activate, engage, retain and monetise audiences across the customer lifecycle.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

**CRM Strategy & Leadership**

* Develop Better Collective's group-wide CRM and lifecycle strategy.
* Establish CRM principles, standards and best practices across brands.
* Create a scalable operating model balancing central CRM expertise with local brand execution.
* Identify where CRM can deliver the greatest audience and commercial impact.
* Build CRM roadmaps for priority Better Collective brands.
* Act as the senior CRM subject-matter expert across the organisation.

**Customer Lifecycle Management**

Design lifecycle strategies covering:

**Acquisition → Registration → Onboarding → Engagement → Conversion → Retention → Reactivation**

Develop automated programmes including:

* Welcome and onboarding journeys
* Profile completion
* Content discovery
* Personalised sports and player updates
* Newsletter engagement
* Subscription conversion
* Premium product promotion
* Renewal
* Retention
* Churn prevention
* Lapsed-user reactivation
* Win-back programmes

The objective is to create relevant, personalised experiences rather than simply increase communication volume.

**First & Zero-Party Data Activation**

Work closely with Audience, Product and Data teams to translate Better Collective's growing first- and zero-party data capabilities into meaningful customer experiences.

Use behavioural, declared and transactional data to improve:

* Audience segmentation
* Personalisation
* Content recommendations
* Lifecycle triggers
* Subscription propensity
* Retention
* Cross-sell opportunities
* Audience insight

Help establish the connection between **data capture, customer understanding and CRM activation**.

**Multi-Channel CRM**

Develop a coordinated CRM approach across:

* Email
* Newsletters
* App push
* Web push
* In-app messaging
* On-site messaging
* Emerging direct audience channels

Establish channel roles, contact strategies, frequency management and customer communication principles.

Ensure customers receive coordinated experiences rather than disconnected messages from individual channels.

**CRM Technology & Automation**

Partner with Product and Technology teams to maximise Better Collective's CRM technology stack.

Responsibilities include:

* Marketing automation
* Journey orchestration
* Audience segmentation
* Triggered communications
* Dynamic content
* Personalisation
* CRM/CDP integration
* Data flows
* Preference management
* Testing frameworks
* Reporting requirements

Help translate business and customer requirements into practical technology capabilities.

**Measurement & Optimisation**

Create a consistent CRM measurement framework across Better Collective.

Core metrics should include:

* Known-user growth
* Registration conversion
* Newsletter acquisition
* Email engagement
* Push engagement
* Active-user frequency
* Subscription conversion
* Renewal
* Retention
* Reactivation
* Revenue per known user
* Customer lifetime value

Move CRM measurement beyond opens and clicks toward **customer behaviour and commercial outcomes**.

**Experimentation**

Establish a structured CRM experimentation programme covering:

* A/B testing
* Send frequency
* Timing
* Content
* Segmentation
* Personalisation
* Offers
* Lifecycle triggers
* Channel combinations

Create mechanisms for successful experiments to be documented and scaled across Better Collective brands.

**Stakeholder Leadership**

CRM at Better Collective sits across multiple disciplines.

The CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager will therefore work closely with:

**Audience** — audience strategy, segmentation and zero/first-party data

**Product** — registration, logged-in experiences and product journeys

**Data & BI** — customer data, segmentation and measurement

**Technology** — CRM platforms, integrations and automation

**Editorial** — content propositions and newsletters

**Commercial** — monetisation and customer value

**Subscription Teams** — acquisition, renewal and retention

**Compliance** — consent, GDPR, PECR and data governance

Strong stakeholder leadership will be critical to the success of the role.

## Job requirements

We are looking for an experienced CRM leader who combines strategic thinking with the ability to turn strategy into operational programmes.

The successful candidate will ideally have:

* Significant experience leading CRM, lifecycle or customer engagement programmes.
* Strong knowledge of email marketing and marketing automation.
* Experience developing sophisticated customer lifecycle strategies.
* Strong understanding of customer segmentation and personalisation.
* Experience working with large customer databases.
* Experience using behavioural and transactional data to improve communications.
* Strong understanding of CRM technology and platform capabilities.
* Experience working across Product, Data, Technology, Marketing and Commercial teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills.
* Experience managing CRM teams, agencies or specialist partners.
* Strong analytical and commercial mindset.
* Demonstrable experience connecting CRM activity to measurable business outcomes.

Experience within **digital media, subscriptions, publishing, sports, gaming or high-frequency digital consumer products** would be particularly valuable.

#### **Leadership Profile**

The role requires someone who can operate at both strategic and practical levels.

You should be comfortable moving between:

**Strategy ↔ Execution**

**Customer ↔ Commercial**

**Data ↔ Communications**

**Technology ↔ Marketing**

**Central Strategy ↔ Local Brand Requirements**

You will need to influence senior stakeholders while also being comfortable working directly with teams responsible for delivering CRM programmes.

**First 3 Months**

* Audit CRM capabilities across priority Better Collective brands.
* Establish baseline CRM KPIs.
* Map existing lifecycle communications.
* Identify immediate optimisation opportunities.
* Define the group CRM strategy and operating principles.
* Prioritise brands and lifecycle use cases.

CRM becomes a measurable growth engine supporting:

**Audience Engagement | Registration | Subscription | Retention | Revenue | Customer Lifetime Value**

**Director, Regional Distribution & Logistics Lead, EUMEA**

**Hybrid – Dublin or Cork**

**Closing Date: 30th October 2026**

The Director, Regional Distribution & Logistics Leader, EUMEA is the accountable leader for the design, performance and transformation of the end-to-end distribution network serving Europe, the Middle East and Africa. The role sits on the Global Distribution & Trade leadership team and holds regional accountability across clinical, commercial and development-science product flows, from release at the manufacturing or contract site through to delivery at the customer, patient-facing provider or clinical site.

The scope of the role extends beyond hub operations. The Director owns the regional logistics service provider (LSP) network as a portfolio — and is accountable for how that network is structured, governed, contracted and continuously improved. The Director is expected to lead a multi-year transformation of the EUMEA distribution operating model and network design in support of the company’s growth, portfolio expansion and new-market entry agenda, and to act as the single senior distribution partner to Regional Supply Chain, Commercial, Market Access, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, Trade Compliance and Technical Operations leadership in the region.

This is a leadership role in a highly regulated environment where decisions directly affect the continuity of supply of life-saving therapies. The Director is expected to set direction rather than execute to direction, to resolve issues at peer-leadership level without escalation, and to build the regional organisation and capability required for the future-state model.

Note that individual responsibilities may include all or part of the responsibilities defined below depending on individual experience and abilities, and may change to best support ongoing business needs.

**Responsibilities:**

**Network Design, Strategy & Business Model Transformation**

* Own the EUMEA distribution network strategy: define the future-state footprint, flow paths, inventory positioning, service tiers and channel model required to support portfolio growth, new launches, new market entry and evolving customer and patient-delivery models.
* Lead the transformation of the regional distribution operating model — including make-versus-buy decisions, hub and satellite structure, direct-to-customer and direct-to-patient flows, and the transition from a hub-operations model to a governed multi-partner network.
* Build and own the multi-year regional distribution roadmap, with a clearly articulated business case, benefit profile, investment requirement and delivery plan; secure endorsement through the appropriate governance forums.
* Sponsor and direct network design analytics and scenario modelling (cost-to-serve, service, working capital, risk, carbon) to underpin design decisions, and translate the output into executable change.
* Represent EUMEA in the design of the global distribution model, ensuring the region’s requirements shape global standards, systems and processes rather than being managed as exceptions.
* Lead the distribution workstream for regional business development activity, in-licensing, divestments and integrations, and for country entry and exit.

**Logistics Service Provider (LSP) & Third-Party Network Ownership**

* Hold end-to-end accountability for the current regional 3PL, LSP and TSP network, as well as including new partnerships: strategy, segmentation, sourcing, selection, onboarding, qualification, performance governance, remediation and exit.
* Lead the design and stand-up of the governance framework for the expanded partner network — tiered operating reviews, quarterly and annual business reviews, executive steering, escalation pathways and decision rights — and chair the senior-level forums.
* Own the commercial relationship with regional partners in close collaboration with Regional Supply Chain, Procurement and Legal: negotiate and steward contracts, rate cards, service level agreements, quality agreements, incentive and remedy mechanisms, and manage the contract lifecycle.
* Ensure clear articulation of Good Distribution Practice responsibilities, quality agreements, escalation routes and performance metrics across every external partner, in partnership with Supply Chain Quality.
* Drive value from the partner base: cost-to-serve reduction, service improvement, network consolidation where appropriate, dual-sourcing and resilience, and joint continuous-improvement and innovation programmes.
* Lead onboarding and integration of new partners and new flows into the network without disruption to supply, including validated shipping lanes, systems integration, data flows and business continuity provisions.

**Enterprise Partnership & Stakeholder Leadership**

* Act as the senior distribution leader and single point of accountability for the EUMEA region, partnering directly with Commercial, Market Access, Medical, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, Trade Compliance, Regional Supply Chain and Clinical Supply Chain leadership.
* Sit on the relevant regional and functional leadership teams; bring distribution insight into commercial planning, launch readiness, S&OP and long-range planning, and shape those plans rather than react to them.
* Own distribution launch readiness for the region: represent Distribution on launch and country-entry teams, define the fulfilment model per market, and commit to and deliver the readiness plan.
* Build senior external relationships with logistics partners, carriers, wholesalers, distributors, customers and, where relevant, regulators and industry bodies; represent the company externally on regional distribution matters.
* Influence and secure alignment across the enterprise without direct authority, resolving competing priorities at peer level and escalating only genuine trade-off decisions.
* Communicate the distribution vision, strategy and performance narrative credibly to executive audiences, including Executive Committee / regional leadership team level.

**Operational, Quality & Compliance Accountability**

* Retain ultimate regional accountability for distribution and order fulfilment performance: order-to-delivery cycle time, on-time in-full, shipment integrity, temperature excursion rate, complaint and deviation performance, and customer service outcomes.
* Ensure the network operates in full compliance with GDP, applicable national licensing and wholesale dealer requirements, trade and customs regulation, dangerous goods and cold-chain requirements, health and safety standards and internal policy.
* Own the distribution risk profile for the region: risk identification and mitigation, business continuity and contingency planning, serialisation and traceability, product security and anti-diversion, and readiness for regulatory inspection and internal audit.
* Act as regional escalation point and decision-maker for supply-critical events, temperature excursions, product holds, recalls and mock recalls, in partnership with Quality and Regulatory.
* Oversee Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP) and inventory deployment for the regional network, balancing service, cost and expiry risk.
* Own the digital and data agenda for regional distribution: system landscape (ERP / SAP, WMS, TMS, visibility and monitoring platforms), master data quality, control-tower capability and analytics; sponsor the deployment of new technology and automation.

**Financial Ownership**

* Own the regional distribution and logistics budget: build the annual plan and long-range forecast, manage to plan, and deliver committed productivity and cost-to-serve targets.
* Own the business case and capital request for network investment, and be accountable for realised benefit against approved cases.
* Partner with Finance on cost-to-serve transparency, freight and distribution cost drivers, accruals, and the financial impact of network design decisions.
* Partner with Procurement on the regional logistics category strategy, sourcing events and supplier value delivery.

**Organisational Leadership & Talent**

* Lead, structure and develop the EUMEA distribution organisation; design the organisation required by the future-state model and manage the transition to it.
* Build capability in network design, partner governance, data and analytics, and change leadership within the team; develop successors and a pipeline of talent for the wider function.
* Set performance and development standards, manage performance, and create an inclusive, high-accountability, patient-focused culture.
* As a member of the Global Distribution & Trade leadership team, contribute to functional strategy, resourcing, budget and talent decisions beyond own region, and lead or sponsor global initiatives.
* Lead change: define and communicate the vision for the region, bring the organisation and external partners through significant model change, and sustain engagement through ambiguity.

**Scope:**

This role is accountable for the compliant and reliable movement of life-saving therapies across the EUMEA region. Decisions made in this role are of critical nature in mitigating risk to the business, to regulatory standing and to continuity of supply to patients.

* Geography: Multiple markets across Europe, Middle East and Africa, including direct, distributor, tender and named-patient / early-access channels.
* Third-party network:  logistics service providers, carriers and regional and in-market storage locations.
* Financial: direct budget accountability; influence total regional cost-to-serve.
* People:  direct reports, total organisation, and contracted workers operating on the company’s behalf.

**Attributes required**

* A firm commitment to the company’s cultural beliefs and values.
* Consistent track record of exceeding objectives in roles of increasing leadership complexity.
* Ability to set direction and achieve results through others, including without direct reporting lines and through external partners.
* Executive presence and credibility with senior internal and external stakeholders; able to synthesise complexity into clear recommendations and decisions.
* Strong strategic and commercial judgement combined with the operational depth to be credible on detail.
* High level of accountability and a demonstrated ability to act as a change agent in a highly regulated industry.
* Comfort with ambiguity, competing priorities and constant change without losing sight of the overall business.
* Proactive and energetic outlook with an unwillingness to accept the status quo.

**Decision Rights:**

The role holder is expected to decide, without escalation, on:

* Regional network design and flow-path changes within an approved strategy and budget envelope.
* LSP performance management actions, remediation plans, and allocation of volume within the qualified partner base.
* Supply-critical event response for the region, including hold, re-route and expedite decisions.
* Regional organisation design, resourcing and talent decisions within approved headcount.

The role holder recommends, and jointly decides with the Senior Director, Global Distribution & Trade and the relevant governance forum, on:

* Selection, appointment or exit of a logistics service provider, and material contract commitments.
* Capital investment and material change to the regional operating model.
* Market entry and exit fulfilment models.

* In lieu of the above, other undergraduate degree plus substantial continuing education in logistics or extended supply chain management.
* Lean Six Sigma certification preferred, ideally to green-belt level; APICS (CPIM / CSCP), CILT or equivalent professional certification advantageous.

**Experience:**

* Minimum of 10–12 years’ experience in logistics, distribution or supply chain management, with at least 5 years leading teams, in a pharmaceutical, biotech or comparably regulated environment.
* Demonstrated accountability for a multi-country distribution network, including ownership of the third-party network rather than oversight of a single site or provider.
* Proven experience sourcing, negotiating, onboarding and governing 3PL / LSP partnerships at contract-owner level, including performance remediation and provider transition.
* Track record of leading supply chain or distribution transformation: network redesign, operating model change, system implementation or major service transition, delivered with measurable benefit.
* Experience operating as the senior functional partner to commercial and regional leadership, including at launch and in new market entry.
* Deep working knowledge of GDP, wholesale distribution licensing, cold chain and ambient distribution, trade compliance, import / export and customs, and dangerous goods requirements across EMEA.
* Cold chain, cryogenic, biologics and / or advanced therapy (cell and gene) distribution experience highly desirable.

British Transport Police (BTP) is the national police force for the rail network throughout Great Britain. We are the ‘Guardians of the Railway,’ putting passenger safety at the heart of what we do. Our values are simply: We Care, We Do the Right Thing, We Strive to Be Better Every Day, We Are One BTP, and We Are Proud to Protect. Join us and help create an environment where we can all be our best every day.

**The Opportunity:**

Calls can come at any time, which is why our Communications Officers work within a core shift pattern that covers 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. This vital role involves answering both emergency and non-emergency calls and directing police resources across Great Britain to where they’re needed most.

As part of our dedicated team, you’ll receive comprehensive training and ongoing support to prepare you for the wide variety of calls and responsibilities you’ll encounter. Whether it’s a life-threatening emergency or a routine enquiry, your ability to remain calm, compassionate, and professional is essential. You’ll need to think on your feet, provide reassurance, and gather accurate information to ensure the appropriate police response is deployed swiftly and effectively.

In return, we offer an attractive salary and a dynamic operational role where you’ll play a key part in protecting the public and our stakeholders from harm and making a real difference every day.

 

**As a****Communications Officer, you will be working in a safety-critical role and be responsible for:**

* Handling calls, dispatching radio messages, and managing police responses to incidents.
* Accurately recording information and assessing it to determine the appropriate level of responses.
* Effectively managing emergency telephone calls, evaluating the urgency of the incident, and prioritising police responses when necessary.
* Obtaining and evaluating information to determine response criteria and deployment levels using THRIVE and NSIR, prioritising public and officer safety at all times.
* Monitoring incidents and providing advice, deployment and direction of appropriate resources via radio to ensure a suitable and effective responses.

* Effective communication skills.

* Access to the Transport Benevolent Fund for health, welfare, and financial support.

For more information, visit the Royal London dedicated pension page or email us at Pension-Queries@btp.police.uk. Note: If you are an existing member of Police Staff in the RPS, your pension will not be affected.

**Additional Information:** 

**Interview process:** This role involves a first stage telephone interview, followed by prioritisation, typing and listening tests which upon successful completion will lead to a face-to-face competency based interview.
