Customer-Facing · Remote, Europe, Africa or Asia

### **About Caliza**

Caliza is commercial banking infrastructure for companies that operate across borders. Most global businesses still piece together several banks, FX providers and spreadsheets to move money. Caliza replaces that with one platform and API: hold USD accounts, collect and pay in 33+ currencies, and convert between fiat and stablecoins, over local rails, SWIFT or stablecoins, in minutes instead of days. On top of that, we’re building the treasury layer: programmable accounts, approval policies, automated reconciliation and working capital, run by a customer’s finance team or their AI agents.

Our customers are importers, exporters, FX brokers, payment companies and fintechs across the Americas, Europe, Africa and Asia. We’re licensed and regulated across our core markets, and our team has built financial infrastructure at Visa, Nubank, EBANX, Flutterwave, Upstart, Intuit and Silicon Valley Bank.

### **Our backers**

Initialized Capital, Better Tomorrow Ventures, Abstract Ventures, New Form Capital, QED Investors, Valor Capital and Quona Capital, along with the founders of Flutterwave, Chipper Cash, Rappi, Pomelo, Dock, Remesa Online and Anchorage.

## **About the role**

Caliza moves money across fiat payment rails in the Americas, Europe and Asia, including Fedwire, ACH, SPEI, SEPA and CNAPS, as well as blockchains. Most payments flow through automatically. When one doesn't, our customers need someone who can work out exactly what happened, explain it clearly, and get it resolved.

That's this role. When a customer asks "where's my payment?", you'll own the answer. You'll follow the payment from their API call, through our internal systems and ledger, out to our partner banks, the payment rail or the blockchain, and back. Then you'll explain what you found to the customer, push the bank for answers when needed, and hand our engineers a precise problem when something is genuinely broken.

You don't need to be an expert in every system a payment touches, but you need to be able to follow one through all of them. You're comfortable reading logs, querying a database and decoding a bank message, and equally comfortable explaining what you found to a customer, a bank or an engineer. You'll build a deep understanding of how our rails really behave over time; we'll teach you the Caliza-specific parts.

**Location:** Europe, Africa, or Asia. You'll be based there so customers get help during their working hours, but the role covers every rail we operate, not just the ones in your region. Professional English required.

## **In your first six months, you'll**

* Learn how payments flow through Caliza end to end, across fiat rails and stablecoins.
* Within three months, understand all of our rails well enough to handle most customer payment issues on your own, whichever rail they're on.
* Own customer payment investigations during your hours, across every rail, keeping customers informed from first message to resolution.
* Write runbooks for the issues you see most, so the rest of the team can rely on them.
* Build at least one tool or automation that measurably reduces manual work.

## **What you'll be doing**

* Be the technical point of contact for customers with payment problems, especially when the answer isn't obvious.
* Answer technical API questions from live customers, such as failed webhooks, error codes or unexpected payment statuses. Helping new customers integrate before launch is handled separately by engineering.
* Trace payments across our API, internal systems, ledger, partner banks, rails and blockchain to find where things stand and what happens next.
* Tell expected behavior from a real bug, and escalate to engineering with clear evidence when it's a bug.
* Work with partner banks and providers on investigations, returns and recalls.
* Support compliance with information requests about specific payments.
* Tag the root cause of each issue so we can fix the most common ones for good.
* Review new rails and corridors before launch, bringing an operational view of how they'll fail.
* Write SQL queries and scripts to automate repetitive work.

## **What we're looking for**

* 3+ years in a technical, customer-facing role at a fintech, payments company, bank or API-first business, such as technical support, payment operations or implementation.
* A solid understanding of how payments work: statuses, settlement, cutoffs, finality, returns and recalls. Experience with any major rail is fine; we'll teach you ours.
* Comfort reading JSON API requests, logs and webhooks.
* Working SQL, and some scripting in Python or similar.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools in your daily work, for scripting, investigation or documentation, with the judgment to check what they produce.
* A methodical approach to investigations: you form hypotheses and check them, rather than guessing.
* Clear, calm communication with customers, especially when the full answer isn't known yet.
* Comfort with high autonomy and ambiguity in a fast-moving, remote startup.

## **Nice to have**

* Hands-on experience with any of our rails: Fedwire, ACH, SPEI, SEPA (SCT and SCT Inst) or CNAPS. Experience across more than one region is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with ISO 20022 payment messages (e.g. pacs.002, pacs.004, camt.053, camt.056).
* Experience with stablecoins, crypto wallets or block explorers.
* Experience working with partner or sponsor banks on investigations.
* Familiarity with double-entry accounting and reconciliation.

We use AI tools every day and expect you to as well, for scripting, investigation and documentation alike. You own what you produce with them: you check it, understand it, and stand behind it. As a Research Translation Executive, you will be responsible for the development and implementation of plans for translation of CRUK funded research at specified key CRUK-funded sites across your region, this role will be focused on the Cambridge region. This will include working with oncology researchers to proactively identify projects and technologies with patient benefit potential, including setting the intellectual property strategy and driving project development by working with a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders.

  

You will have the opportunity to interact with researchers working on a wide range of scientific and technological areas, including drug discovery/development, biomarkers, diagnostics, medical devices, digital health, and research reagents.

* Working with Cambridge Regional Translation Executive to develop S&E strategic initiatives.

* Play an active role in the management and development of regional translational project portfolio.

* Build and maintain strong, integrated relationships with senior management figures and CRUK-funded scientists at your specified major Centre/Institute/University(s)

* Develop a deep understanding of the research landscape at allocated CRUK site(s) and identify increased collaborative and translational funding opportunities to accelerate progress

* With minimal line management input required, provide appropriate technology transfer services and manage intellectual property protection for portfolio projects in a timely manner.

* Work collaboratively with colleagues from other S&E regions to proactively seek collaborative and synergistic interactions.

* Work in collaboration with internal colleagues focused in other CP core function teams to deliver on CP’s overall operations, performance and strategies;

* Contribute to developing and implementing strategy to enhance and grow the entrepreneurial culture across CRUK-funded researchers, to maximise output of CRUK funding

* Support CP, (including CancerTools) and R&I management with cross department activities as required

* Provide expert translational advice to scientists, major centres and institutions through well-developed communication links

* With minimal line management input required, undertake routine contract negotiation and management for allocated sites in liaison with BD&T and Legal colleagues as required e.g. research collaboration agreements.

**What are you looking for?**

  

As job titles vary across organisations, you may currently be working as Senior Translation Manager, Senior Commercialisation Manager or Senior Technology Transfer Manager. Whatever your current job title, you will need to have:

  

* PhD (or equivalent) in a scientific discipline, ideally in oncology, life sciences, pharma, medicine, or related.

* In-depth experience in translating discovery research and pre-clinical science gained in sectors such as medical technologies, diagnostics, healthcare technologies and pharmaceuticals.  This experience may have been gained in academic technology transfer, industry, healthcare, academia or in non-profit organisations.

* In-depth Knowledge and awareness of oncology drug/technology discovery, IP protection and development and associated science

* Ideally, good working knowledge and experience of the patent filing and prosecution process.

* Experience of research-related contracts including MTAs, CDAs

* Grasping scientific and technical concepts quickly and translating these into commercially viable proposals.

* Working effectively with key stakeholders internally and externally, showing excellent influencing skills and, where appropriate, having tenacity and persistence.

* Deploying excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both verbally and in writing with the ability to build and maintain strong relationships.

* Work collaboratively within cross-functional teams to deliver the scientific, commercial, and operational objectives of the overall function.

* Scientific judgement and project management skills, together with a talent for business acumen and operational delivery.

* Experience of developing and implementing strategic initiatives aimed at maximising collaboration and productivity.

Manager, Data Scientist - Alternative Data Strategy

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

  

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

  

**Team Description**

The Alternative Data Strategy team drives credit decisioning forward by integrating non-traditional datasets into US Card strategies. As a Data Scientist, you will evaluate emerging vendors and data products, engineer high-impact features, build scalable processing and monitoring systems, and serve as the dedicated data domain expert guiding all users on dataset applications. In this role, you will also navigate risk governance for vendor models and build challenger models using new data to enhance existing ones. The scope involves rich cross-functional collaboration and continuous learning opportunities.

  

**Role Description**

**In this role, you will:**

* Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers love
* Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data
* Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation
* Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals
* This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.

  

**The Ideal Candidate is:**

* Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them.
* Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.
* Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms.
* Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning.
* A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science.

  

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:
  + A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 6 years of experience performing data analytics
  + A Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field)  or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 4 years of experience performing data analytics
  + A PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 1 year of experience performing data analytics
* At least 1 year of experience leveraging open source programming languages for large scale data analysis
* At least 1 year of experience working with machine learning
* At least 1 year of experience utilizing relational databases

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) plus 3 years of experience in data analytics

Parents whose children have attended Twinkle Stars have said:

***"I am so grateful to the staff they helped my son and can see a huge improvement. They listened to us about concerns for our son and did all they could to support us. Can't fault any of them. Our son loves going there".***

A member of staff has said:

***' I love working at Twinkle Star. The support from management is amazing, they are always there if you need anything. They are happy to offer opportunities for you to develop professionally and also learn new skills. I have worked in a few childcare settings and Twinkle Star has supported me the most, in my professional develop to carry out my job confidently. If you have a passion for working with children, Twinkle Star is the setting you would want to work for. '***

Here's what the Care Inspectorate Wales said in our last inspection:

***'Practitioners provide a nurturing and caring environment where the needs of the children come first... The indoor and outdoor play areas provide a rich learning environment for children to explore and learn, and practitioners adapt the provision and resources in response to children's interests.'***

Flying Start is a Welsh Government funded programme targeted at children under 4 years of age and their families. Part-time childcare for 2-3 year olds is one part of the Flying Start offer.

Twinkle Stars Flying Start childcare setting is part of Cardiff Council's Cardiff Parenting and Play Service, in Cardiff Early Help. You can learn more about elements of Early Help by visiting the website .

The childcare setting is supported by a committed and dedicated leadership team within Cardiff Parenting and Play. We are part of a wider multi agency team of professionals who deliver Parenting and Play Services across Cardiff. ## The Role

CircuitHub makes electronics on demand. Engineers upload a circuit board design; we buy the parts, build the board in our own robotic factory and ship it. More and more of that business is now run by AI agents, and we want you to help build them.

These aren't chatbots. Our agents have real jobs:

* **They inspect boards.** An agent checks camera images of every panel we build for wrong, rotated or missing parts.
* **They program robots.** Agents read datasheets so our pick-and-place machines know how to handle each new part.
* **They watch the factory.** They spot stray parts in robot storage, diagnose printer faults and clear stuck machines.
* **They run the back office.** They book supplier invoices, chase late orders, explain quotes and triage bugs.
* **They write our code.** Most of what our team ships starts in an agent session.

## What you'll do

Find a process people still do by hand and automate it end to end: decide what needs judgement and what needs plain code, build the tools, and prove it works before it runs alone. Then make it cheaper, faster and right more often. You'll also improve the platform every agent runs on, and work closely with the people your work serves, from factory operators to finance.

## How we build

* **Evals first.** An agent earns the right to work alone: blind tests against people's verdicts, shadow runs beside the humans, replays of past decisions. We track accuracy and cost per run, and re-test whenever we change a model, a prompt or the effort level.
* **Agents judge, code writes.** Agents return structured answers. Plain code checks them against a second source and makes every change.
* **Classical first, model second.** Cheap vision and maths narrow the problem so the model only looks where it matters.
* **Safe by construction.** Agents work in sandboxed cloud machines that never hold real credentials, and tool calls are built so a business action can't run twice.

## Recent work

* Image alignment ranks the parts on each board photo. The worst 20% of parts hold about 90% of real defects, so the agent only inspects those. In a blind re-run it caught all 13 defects operators had marked.
* A photo check for stray parts in robot storage scored 10 out of 10 blind, at about 8¢ a photo. The model it replaced caught about half.
* Agent tool calls leave durable receipts, so a session killed mid-deploy resumes without sending the same email or order twice.
* Invoices extracted from supplier emails matched what a person had entered 66 times out of 66.
* A constraint solver replans the whole factory every two minutes, across robots, ovens and people.

## What we look for

* You've put LLM agents into production and can tell us what broke and how you knew it was working.
* You're a strong software engineer first. Most of this job is real engineering, not prompting: concurrency, idempotency, data modelling, security.
* You build the eval before you trust the result.
* You like the physical world: cameras, robots, parts rotated by 90°.
* Bonus: computer vision, optimisation or electronics.

**About Coffee Meets Bagel**

Coffee Meets Bagel is a women-founded company with a mission to give everyone a chance at love. We build products that help people form meaningful connections and work closely across Engineering, Product, Design, and Data to solve meaningful customer and business problems.

We are modernizing both our product and engineering organization, investing in next-generation recommendation and GenAI capabilities and using AI-first development practices across the software lifecycle.

* Own infrastructure security priorities in partnership with a senior external security advisor, translating risks and recommendations into actionable work and driving improvements across cloud infrastructure and engineering systems.
* Partner with backend engineers on system architecture, reliability, operational simplicity, and infrastructure improvements, and contribute to backend services when that is the best way to solve a technical or product problem.
* Use AI-assisted development across infrastructure design, implementation, automation, testing, debugging, incident investigation, review, and documentation while maintaining human accountability for security, reliability, correctness, and production outcomes.

* Strong fundamentals in Linux, networking, distributed systems, cloud security, reliability, and production operations.
* Experience with CI/CD, observability, incident response, capacity planning, and designing systems for failure and recovery.
* Experience operating production databases and shared data infrastructure, including performance, availability, backup, and migration concerns.
* Strong programming skills in Python, Go, or another language, with a preference for durable automation over manual operations and an interest in contributing to backend systems.
* Experience managing cloud and infrastructure costs.
* Experience with cloud security, IAM, vulnerability management, security reviews, and working closely with security specialists.
* Ability to independently own an infrastructure domain, prioritize investments, communicate clearly with engineering and business stakeholders, and collaborate effectively with backend engineers and specialized external experts.

**Nice to Have**

* Backend application or API development experience.

**Our Technology Stack**

Our environment includes **AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, PostgreSQL/RDS, Redis, Elasticsearch, Python, Go, CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling.**

At CMB, infrastructure is an engineering function, not just an operations function. We automate repetitive work, design systems for failure and recovery, and partner closely with product engineers to make reliability, security, cost efficiency, and developer velocity part of the architecture.

We operate with an **AI-first engineering culture**, using AI throughout design, implementation, review, testing, debugging, incident investigation, and documentation while keeping engineers accountable for security, correctness, reliability, and production outcomes.

We also value **depth plus breadth.** You may join with infrastructure as your strongest area, but we encourage engineers to expand into backend and broader product systems as their skills and impact grow.

# Salesforce QA Analyst

Veriforce is a leading provider of compliance, risk management, and workforce development solutions. Our mission is to enhance the safety, efficiency, and reliability of our clients' operations through innovative technology and services. We believe in creating a culture of excellence and continuous improvement, empowering our team to deliver exceptional results and drive success for our clients.

At Veriforce, we are committed to fostering a dynamic and inclusive work environment where creativity and collaboration thrive. Our team is passionate about making a positive impact and is dedicated to upholding the highest standards of integrity and professionalism. By joining Veriforce, you become part of a community that values innovation, respects diverse perspectives, and encourages ongoing professional growth.  
  
The **Salesforce QA Analyst** role plays a pivotal role in delivering high-quality, reliable Salesforce solutions by leading the testing efforts across the software development life cycle. This position involves **collaborating with cross-functional teams** to ensure that customisation, integrations, and core Salesforce functionalities meet business and technical requirements.

## What that means day to day

* **Test Planning:** Collaborate with the development, business analysis, and project management teams to understand project requirements, define test strategies, and develop comprehensive test plans.
* **Test Case Development:** Design, document, and maintain detailed test cases and test scenarios to validate Salesforce functionality, customizations, and integrations.
* **Manual Testing:** Perform thorough manual testing of Salesforce applications, identifying and documenting defects, and working closely with developers to ensure timely resolution.
* **Automation Testing:** Develop and maintain automated test scripts using industry-standard tools and frameworks to improve testing efficiency, coverage, and repeatability.
* **Regression Testing:** Conduct regression testing to ensure that existing functionalities are not adversely affected by new changes or updates.
* **Performance Testing:** Evaluate the performance and scalability of Salesforce applications, identify potential bottlenecks, and recommend optimisations to improve performance.
* **User Acceptance Testing (UAT):** Coordinate and conduct UAT sessions with business stakeholders to validate that the solutions meet their needs and expectations.
* **Defect Management:** Track, manage, and report defects using a defect tracking system, ensuring that all issues are addressed and resolved in a timely manner.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Stay updated with the latest Salesforce features, best practices, and industry trends to continuously enhance testing processes and methodologies.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery of high-quality Salesforce solutions.
* **Documentation:** Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation of test plans, test cases, test results, and defects to ensure transparency and traceability.
* **Risk Assessment:** Identify potential risks and issues related to Salesforce implementations and provide recommendations for mitigation.
* **Training and Mentoring:** Provide guidance and support to junior testers and team members, sharing knowledge and best practices to enhance the overall testing capability of the team.
* **Test Environment Management:** Set up and manage test environments, including configuring Salesforce sandboxes and ensuring data integrity.
* **Reporting:** Generate and distribute test execution status reports, highlighting key metrics, test coverage, and defect trends.

## What you’ll need to be successful

**Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.  
  
**Experience:** Minimum of 3 years of experience in software testing, with at least 2 years focused on Salesforce QA testing, with a focus on **Automation.**  
  
**Technical Skills:**

* Proficiency in testing Salesforce applications, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and custom solutions.
* **Proficiency in Automation Testing ideally Playwright or Cypress.**
* Writing test scripts.
* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, tools, and processes.
* Ability to write clear, concise, and comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts.
* Familiarity with defect tracking systems, such as Jira or Bugzilla.

**Soft Skills:**

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration abilities, with the capability to work effectively in a team environment.
* Attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Certifications:** Salesforce Administrator, Salesforce Advanced Administrator, or Salesforce Platform App Builder certification.
* **Experience:** Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and participating in Agile development teams.
* **Technical Skills:**
* Familiarity with Apex, Visualforce, and Lightning components.
* Knowledge of Salesforce integration tools and techniques, such as REST/SOAP APIs and middleware solutions

Welcome to ConocoPhillips, where innovation and excellence create a platform for opportunity and growth. Come realize your full potential here.

**Who We Are**

We are one of the world’s largest independent exploration and production companies, based on proved reserves and production of liquids and natural gas. With operations and activities in 13 countries, we explore for, develop, and produce crude oil and natural gas globally. We are challenged with an important job to safely find and deliver energy to the world. Our employees are critical to our success, and with them we power civilization.

We’re grounded by our SPIRIT Values – safety, people, integrity, responsibility, innovation, and teamwork. These values position us to deliver strong performance in a dynamic business – but not at all costs. We believe it’s not just what we do – it’s how we do it – that sets us apart.

**Fostering an Inclusive Work Environment**

To deliver superior performance, we create an environment that respects the contributions and differences of every individual. Wherever possible, we use these differences to drive competitive business advantage, personal growth and, ultimately, create business success.

**Job Summary**

The Job Opportunity  
This role supports the Commercial team which is tasked with optimizing our global equity positions and supporting our Joint Venture projects as well as the global crude marketing portfolio. Commercial team activities include developing new markets to support current and future production, sourcing supplies, originating receiving terminal usage rights and term sales, and trading cargos. Ship Operator core activities include pre-voyage, post voyage, and active voyage management for chartered tankers.   
  
Position Summary  
The Ship Operator is responsible for the safe, efficient, and commercially optimized execution of Crude & LPG voyages. This role manages the day-to-day operations of time-chartered and spot vessels, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, regulatory standards, and company policies. The operator serves as the key liaison between internal stakeholders and external partners including shipowners, terminals, brokers, and port agents. This position requires a confident and capable leader who can take ownership of complex operations, make sound decisions under pressure, and guide others with clarity and authority. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong leadership skills, a proactive mindset, and the ability to influence outcomes across diverse teams and stakeholders. The ship operator provides technical and commercial marine expertise to all ConocoPhillips business units, operations and projects by evaluating and proposing solutions to commercial marine challenges.  
  
The Ship Operator is responsible for the voyage coordination, vessel scheduling, and related commercial activities for the support of tankers for ConocoPhillips worldwide. This position is also responsible for supporting a wide range of marine related projects by utilizing maritime field experience to provide technical expertise to global operations, projects and joint ventures.  
The role is also accountable for data integrity across voyage systems, emissions and regulatory reporting readiness, and the effective management of claims, agents, and third-party performance.

**Position Overview**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Voyage Management**

• Ensure successful voyage execution. This includes development & issuance of voyage orders, daily voyage status and reporting, bunker and fuel planning, effective communications with service providers, agent nomination, voyage documentation management, IMOS data integrity, IMOS/Veslink data integrity, timely completion of voyage cost allocations (VCAs), process hire, freight and port cost invoices, capture and allocate off-hire events, voyage file management, incident reporting and monitoring, and Owner performance management

• Maintain accurate voyage costs in IMOS and reconcile transfers to ETRM/ERP with Finance.

• Coordinate with terminals and port agents to manage berthing schedules, cargo documentation, and operational readiness.

• Examine vessel routing based on weather, fuel efficiency, cargo requirements, and geopolitical considerations to ensure safe and cost-effective cargo delivery.

• Develop and demonstrate in-depth working knowledge of IMOS and related system integrations to ensure accurate voyage planning, execution, and reporting across commercial and operational workflows.

• Plan and execute marine fuel bunkering operations in coordination with suppliers and vessel masters.

• Accountable for crude and performance claims and claim related calculations.

• Collaborate with finance and chartering teams to ensure accurate financial reporting.

• Lead laytime calculations and demurrage negotiations; validate SOF integrity, berth/port definitions.

• Manage charterparty compliance (NOR validity, speed/consumption, pumping, heating, shifting/ice/interruption clauses), off‐hire capture, liquidated damages, and performance claims; coordinate with P&I/H&M/War regarding relevant risks.

• Oversee bunker planning and procurement; fuel quality standards, sampling, and fuel quality/quantity claims.

• Agree commercial speed and routing recommendations with the Master/owner, subject to safety requirements to balance TCE, CII targets, and EU ETS cost exposure; utilize AIS/port analytics to forecast congestion and schedule risk.

• Maintain owner and agent performance dashboards with KPIs.

Operational and Technical Management

• Demonstrate an understanding of the various types of reliquefication systems, containment systems, main engines, ship designs, etc. and be capable of articulating how they impact operational efficiency to a non-technical audience.

• Demonstrate a detailed understanding of the inter-relationships across cargo tank pressure management, fuel consumption at various speed requirements, cool-down & pressure reduction requirements prior to cargo transfer, forced vs. natural boil-off, Gas Combustion Unit usage, and be able to explain in detail how these impact the cost of a voyage as well as providing guidance as to the most efficient operational choices.

• Demonstrate an understanding of ship navigation including, voyage planning, weather routing, Vessel traffic separation schemes, congested areas, High Risk Areas, etc. and be able to explain in detail how these impact the cost of a voyage

• Support cargo handling procedures including tank preparation, loading, discharge operations, crude oil washing, custody transfer and measurement protocols

• Monitor and report on tank pressures, temperatures, and reliquefication system performance.

• Ensure vessels comply with terminal compatibility requirements and vetting standards.

• Monitor fuel consumption to optimize routing for minimized costs and emissions.

• Monitor terminal‐vessel compatibility efforts to ensure completion on time

• Support hull/propeller performance monitoring and cleaning triggers with owners to protect speed/consumption warranties.

Compliance & Risk Management

• Ensure adherence to international regulations including IGF Code, IGC Code, MARPOL, and OCIMF standards.

• Maintain awareness of geopolitical and weather-related risks affecting trade routes.

• To the extent within ConocoPhillips’ control, ensure all voyages meet emissions standards, waste management protocols, and sustainability targets.

• Ensure full alignment with marine assurance requirements, including vetting, terminal compatibility, and adherence to internal and external safety and quality standards.

• Ensure sanctions and trade compliance screening (OFAC/EU/UK) for vessels, counterparties, cargoes, routes; assess deceptive shipping practices (AIS gaps, STS exposure, identity masking).

• Examine operational compliance and EU/UK ETS exposure

• Monitor voyage security risk assessments including routing around HRA, WRAP endorsements, and K&R protocols where applicable.

• Manage canal bookings and ice routing per local regulations as appropriate.

Stakeholder Engagement

• Interface with commercial trading desks, charterers, marine assurance, and technical teams.

• Develop and maintain relationships with Masters, third parties, including terminals, agents, owners and suppliers to ensure ConocoPhillips’ general interests are represented and marine operations activities can be completed with maximum efficiency and minimal disruption

• Accountable for global ships agent program, performance management, accurate funding projections, accurate disbursement account closure, including annual performance and metrics review

• Lead vessel performance reviews, validate speed/consumption curves, and collaborate on corrective actions.

Teamwork, Leadership, and Collaboration

• Foster a collaborative work environment by actively engaging with cross-functional teams including chartering, trading, technical, and assurance groups.

• Share operational insights and lessons learned to improve team performance and voyage execution.

• Support peers during high-volume periods and contribute to a culture of mutual respect, accountability, and continuous improvement.

• Actively participate in onboarding and mentoring of new team members, sharing operational knowledge and best practices to accelerate their development and integration.

• Lead by example and provide clear direction, guidance, and support to junior staff and cross-functional partners.

  

## Qualifications

**Required**

·         Bachelor’s degree or higher in Maritime Studies, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field (or equivalent experience).

·         3 or more years of previous relevant experience as a ship operator

·         Advanced level of knowledge of tanker and LNG carrier systems, cargo handling, and voyage planning.

·         Intermediate level of knowledge in laytime and demurrage calculations

·         Basic level of knowledge with IMOS/Veson, Dataloy, or equivalent systems.

·         Basic level of knowledge of statutory codes and frameworks.

·         Basic level of knowledge with sanctions screening, AIS analytics, maritime security, and canal/ice navigation.

·         Ability to maintain IMOS/Veslink data accuracy and ERP integration.

**Job Title: Head of Women’s & Girls’ Cricket**

**Reporting to: Director of Cricket**

**Location: Worcestershire County Cricket Club, New Road, Worcester, WR2 4QQ**

**Contract term: Full time, permanent**

**Background:**

Worcestershire County Cricket Club is one of the 18 major county Cricket clubs which make up the England and Wales Cricket Board. We play to the highest level of professional Cricket with a history stretching back over 155 years. Our vision is to become Worcestershire’s premier destination for live sports, entertainment & hospitality, whilst providing great experiences for everyone who comes to New Road.

We are passionate about our people and strive to make our working environment a welcoming and inclusive one, fuelling ambition with opportunities and support to help our people achieve their personal and professional goals. Our values of Trust, Inclusiveness, Kindness, Resilience and Togetherness resonate across everything we do at the Club and define our culture and behaviours.

**Our Women’s Team:**

Worcestershire County Cricket Club is proud to compete at Tier 2 level with our Women’s Rapids team. Our ambition is to build a strong, sustainable and connected Women’s & Girls’ pathway which develops Worcestershire players, increases the depth and quality of our playing pool and provides a clear route from junior cricket into the senior Women’s team and, for those with the ambition and ability, into professional cricket.

**Purpose of the Role:**

The Head of Women’s & Girls’ Cricket will have overall responsibility and accountability for the direction, performance and development of Women’s & Girls’ cricket at Worcestershire County Cricket Club.

The role will provide leadership across the entire Worcestershire pathway, from the youngest age groups through to the Women’s senior team, ensuring there is a clear and connected approach to identifying, developing and progressing talented players.

A key part of the structure will be the line management and development of a dedicated lead for the younger age-group pathway, who will take day-to-day responsibility for coaching and programme delivery within those age groups. The Head of Women’s & Girls’ Cricket will retain overall accountability for the quality, direction and effectiveness of the whole pathway.

The role itself will have a significant hands-on coaching and performance focus, taking direct responsibility for the coaching, development, preparation and performance of the Women’s senior team and Under-18 programme.

Our ambition is to develop our own players, build a larger group capable of thriving at Tier 2 level and give our most talented and ambitious players the skills, experience and opportunity to progress into professional cricket. Success will therefore be measured not only by results, but by the strength, depth and progression of the Worcestershire player pathway.

The postholder will be responsible for establishing the cricketing philosophy, standards, culture and environment of the senior programme - creating a team that is ambitious, competitive, enjoyable to be part of and recognised for developing players.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities:**

· Provide overall leadership, strategy and accountability for Worcestershire Women’s & Girls’ performance cricket and the complete player pathway.

· Act as Head Coach of the Worcestershire Women’s senior team, EPP and Under-18 programme, leading coaching, training, match preparation, selection, individual player development and performance.

· Establish and lead the culture, playing philosophy, standards and expectations of the senior Women’s programme.

· Develop individual players technically, tactically, physically and mentally, with a strong emphasis on helping players maximise their potential.

· Build greater depth within the Worcestershire playing pathway, increasing the number of players capable of progressing into and succeeding within the senior team.

· Create a clear and visible pathway from junior age-group cricket through U18s and into the senior Women’s team.

· Make the development of home-grown Worcestershire players a central objective of the programme, while appropriately supplementing the squad where necessary.

· Ensure talented players with the ambition and ability to progress beyond Tier 2 are prepared and supported to pursue opportunities within professional cricket.

· Line manage the junior player pathway lead (who will be responsible for the U16 squad and below), setting clear objectives and ensuring high-quality coaching, talent identification and player development throughout the programme.

· Maintain oversight of all age-group programmes and ensure consistency in coaching philosophy, standards, selection and player development across the pathway.

· Lead the identification, tracking and development of talented players and ensure appropriate individual development plans are in place.

· Maintain strong relationships with clubs, schools, partner counties, Tier 1 organisations and other relevant stakeholders to create the best possible development opportunities for Worcestershire players.

· Be accountable for delivery of the Women’s & Girls’ Performance Action Plan and all relevant ECB Minimum Quality Standards.

· Lead and complete the administrative and operational requirements associated with the senior programme and maintain overall oversight of administration across the pathway.

· Be responsible for the Women’s & Girls’ performance budget and ensure resources are deployed effectively against the Club’s strategic priorities.

· Work closely with Science & Medicine and other specialist support services to provide an appropriate performance environment for players.

· Lead and manage coaches and other performance staff, creating a collaborative and development-focused coaching team.

· Attend relevant ECB meetings, CPD and performance forums and ensure Worcestershire remains aligned with best practice in women’s player development.

· Report on the performance, progression and effectiveness of the Women’s & Girls’ programme, including the strength and depth of the player pathway.

**Other responsibilities:**

We expect our people to demonstrate and promote our values at all times to ensure Worcestershire County Cricket Club’s brand is always held in the highest regard both internally and in public. It is expected that you will:

· Be proactive in promoting inclusiveness across the Club and reporting any discrimination that you witness.

· Be committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and adults at risk that visit the Club.

· Promote a positive environment that is welcoming, friendly and supportive.

· Foster a culture of togetherness and commit to contributing to a strong team ethic.

· Be passionate about delivering excellent experiences for players, colleagues, members, supporters and everyone who comes through our doors.

The nature of our work and the size of our team at Worcestershire County Cricket Club requires everyone to be flexible, motivated and an excellent team player.

This Job Description is not an exhaustive list of tasks but represents the key duties and responsibilities required by the role. You may be required to take on such reasonable additional or other responsibilities and tasks as we need from time to time.

**Requirements**

**Person Specification:**

The successful candidate will be an excellent developer of players and leader of a cricket programme, combining high-quality hands-on coaching with the organisational and leadership skills required to oversee the wider pathway.

· Proven experience of coaching and developing talented cricketers, ideally within a performance environment.

· The ability to lead a senior performance team and create an ambitious, positive and high-performing culture.

· A clear philosophy around player development and the ability to translate that philosophy throughout an entire pathway.

· A strong understanding of long-term player development, including talent identification, individual development planning and the transition from age-group to senior cricket.

· A commitment to developing home-grown talent and increasing the number and quality of players progressing through the Worcestershire system.

· The ability to recognise players with the potential to progress into professional cricket and prepare them for that next step.

· Experience of leading and developing other coaches, including effective line management and delegation.

· Strong organisational and administrative skills and the ability to manage the operational requirements of a performance programme.

· An understanding of the ECB Women’s & Girls’ pathway and the evolving domestic structure.

· Experience of managing budgets and allocating resources effectively.

· Strong communication and relationship-management skills, including the ability to work effectively with players, parents, coaches, clubs, schools, partner counties and the ECB.

· An understanding of the role of sports science and medicine within player development.

· A flexible attitude to working irregular and unsocial hours, including evenings, weekends and Bank Holidays.

· The ability to work independently and effectively under pressure.

· A collaborative approach and strong alignment with Worcestershire County Cricket Club’s values.

· A full Driving Licence and the means to travel to training and match venues.

**Safeguarding and Right to Work:**

This role may involve training, supervising, working with and/or being in sole charge of children and young people. The successful applicant will therefore be required to apply for an enhanced disclosure from the Disclosure and Barring Service. Having a criminal record will not necessarily be a bar to obtaining a position.

**You will need to have the Right to Work in the UK or be able to obtain this by the start date. Unfortunately, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.**

**Benefits**

This is a full-time role working 40 hours per week over an average of 5 days. It will include evening and weekend work, particularly during the Cricket season. The annual salary for this role is £32-35k depending on experience.

* National Boys U15s Head Coach

**About Cricket Scotland**

Cricket Scotland is the national governing body for cricket in Scotland. We organise and develop the game at every level, from grassroots participation to international competition, supporting leagues, coaching and community programmes across the country.

Our four-year strategy, Uniting People and Communities through Cricket (2024–2028), sets out our ambition to grow participation and achieve on-field success, bringing people and communities together through cricket. **What you will do**

Within each of these roles, you will be responsible for leading the relevant programme, working with the Head of Performance Pathway (Boys), sport science staff and other national and regional coaches to support players’ development.

Within each role you will:

* Attend training sessions and matches as agreed, and develop tailored training programmes and game day plans for squad members.
* Communicate with players, parents and clubs about the programme, expectations, selection and player feedback, including delivering an induction session for parents.
* Lead selection for winter and summer squads in line with Cricket Scotland’s selection process.
* Work with national and regional coaches to observe players throughout the year and support talent identification and development.
* Complete the performance pathway player monitoring documents for squad members.
* Attend performance coaching group meetings and continuing professional development opportunities provided by Cricket Scotland.

**Person Specification**

To be considered for these roles, you should have a sound practical knowledge, strong communication skills and the ability to plan and organise a player development programme, which includes:

* Significant experience of coaching young and adult cricketers, ideally across regional, national youth or senior performance environments.
* An understanding of performance planning and individual player development plans, supported by practical experience of player development programmes in performance sport.
* Knowledge and understanding of talent identification and development.
* Experience of building constructive relationships with partners and stakeholders, and an understanding of how equality, diversity and inclusion apply in sport.
* Strong interpersonal, organisation and planning skills, with the ability to prioritise, meet deadlines and work independently and as part of a team.
* Confidence using IT systems for communication, player monitoring and reporting, and a flexible approach to meeting the needs of the programme.

In addition, for the **National Boys U15s Head Coach** role, you should also be able to demonstrate experience of coaching or engaging with developing athletes.

**Working with Cricket Scotland**

Each role is part-time, working an average of 4 hours per week. A flexible approach is required, including evening and weekend work in winter and some weekday activity during the summer months.

You will work at a mixture of locations throughout Scotland and the UK.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **About the role**

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Strategist to own our most strategic customer engagements - from first workshop through delivery. You'll sit with executive sponsors, surface the highest-value use cases, turn them into tightly scoped projects, then stay accountable for the outcome, working with the FDE.

You'll typically work in a pod of one Strategist and 1-2 FDEs. You own the executive relationship and the shape of delivery; the FDE embeds with the customer's team and owns the deeper production builds. You'll stay hands-on at the configuration layer week to week, including workflows, integrations, and platform tooling, partnering with the FDE where the build is most complex. You will translate technical build into business outcomes and own the adoption of the build.

This is for someone who combines technical credibility in agentic coding and LLMs with the executive presence to earn trust in the boardroom, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating.

### **What you’ll do**

* **Scope**

  + Partner with customer executive sponsors to scope FDE projects — translating ambiguous business problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
  + Lead technical discovery and architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints to validate that every engagement is technically feasible

  **Deliver**

  + Work side by side with the FDE on the technical build — you own the configuration layer including workflows, settings, integrations, and platform tooling that don't require heavy custom code while the FDE owns the deeper production builds
  + Own technical enablement and adoption: run hands-on training, build playbooks and reference workflows, and coach the customer's team until they're self-sufficient. Adoption is measured by what their users do without you in the room
  + Monitor technical feasibility throughout delivery, adjusting scope with the sponsor when constraints emerge rather than letting engagements drift
  + Identify and scope expansion opportunities as they surface during delivery, in partnership with the account team
  + Escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions
  + Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time

  **Own the executive relationship**

  + Establish and maintain the executive relationship on your engagements, serving as the primary point of contact from kickoff through handoff
  + Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it
  + Translate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions — for the sponsor and for the build team

### **You may be a fit if**

* You've spent 6+ years in Solutions Architecture, Deployment Strategy, technical consulting, or an Engagement Manager seat where you owned scoping and delivery with a technical team in AI-production workflows
* You understand agentic coding and LLMs well enough to hold your own with senior eng: how they behave in production, where they fail, and what a resilient workflow looks like (you don't need to be the person writing the production code)
* You're comfortable hands-on with Cursor workflows, integrations, and platform config, and can read enough Python / JS-TS to partner with an FDE
* You've shipped AI-native workflows past the prototype stage and can tell a real production constraint from a nice-to-have
* You can walk into an unfamiliar enterprise eng org, find the highest-leverage intervention fast, and scope something that delivers concrete value in weeks, not quarters
* You have the executive presence to own the C-suite relationship and the technical credibility to earn trust with their eng leads
* Domain depth in FSI, insurance, telecom, high-tech, healthcare/life sciences, or semiconductor is a strong plus

**Purpose of Job**

The Energy Europe team delivers the Bank's mandate in the electricity sector in Central, Eastern and South Eastern Europe. It makes debt, and equity, investments in the power sector, predominantly focusing on renewable power generation projects as well as electricity storage, transmission and distribution projects working with both public sector clients as well as private sponsors. Its activities are subject to the applicable Energy Sector Strategy and the Green Economy Transition Approach and consistent with the EBRD’s commitment to aligning its activities with the goals of the Paris Agreement. It also plays a key role in advancing policy dialogue to promote green, competitive and liberalised energy markets, with a particular focus on the development of regulatory frameworks to support increased penetration of renewable energy.

The Principal Banker is competent in undertaking all tasks related to, and understands all aspects of, project development and implementation, including project origination, structuring, execution, implementation and monitoring, for all types of investment instruments offered by the Bank.

The Principal Banker will act both as a senior member of a project team or as the Operational Leader (OL) / Transaction Leader leading the processing of an EBRD investment operation.

The Principal Banker, in their role as an operation leader, is expected to take responsibility for effective leadership of their project team/s, supervision of junior banking staff, while contributing to their coaching and providing mentoring assistance, as required.

The Principal Banker’s role also includes elements of business/pipeline development, client management and policy dialogue.

***Please note that we are recruiting for two vacancies through this selection process: one regular role and one short-term(23 months) contract role.***

**Background**

The Project life-cycle involves several stages from origination to signing, followed by implementation and monitoring until full completion and repayment or exit. All the stages involve different tasks such as business marketing, project due diligence analysis, structuring and approval, negotiation and signing of project agreements, disbursement and monitoring.

The role of the Principal Banker is to contribute, as a senior project team member, to the structuring, implementation and monitoring of complex transactions, and to lead, as an operation leader, the development of less complex debt and equity transactions, and the effective implementation and monitoring of an assigned number of portfolio projects, in line with the Bank’s operational objectives.  The Principal Banker supervises, both as senior team member and as operation leader, more junior colleagues to ensure efficient processing of deal flow and portfolio monitoring.

The Principal Banker is able to build and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders in relation to business development, project execution, implementation and monitoring, policy dialogue, co-financing arrangements and donor funding, as applicable.

A substantial degree of independence is given to the Principal Banker, and they are expected to ensure effective project team work and progressively take on overall responsibility for increasingly complex transactions.

# Scientist/Senior Scientist, Mass Spectrometry - Generative Biology Institute

**On-site**Generative Biology InstituteFull time

Oxford, England, United Kingdom

## Description

At the Ellison Institute of Technology (EIT), we're on a mission to translate scientific discovery into real world impact. We bring together visionary scientists, technologists, engineers, researchers, educators and innovators to tackle humanity's greatest challenges in four transformative areas:

* Health, Medical Science & Generative Biology
* Food Security & Sustainable Agriculture
* Climate Change & Managing CO[2]
* Artificial Intelligence & Robotics

This is ambitious work - work that demands curiosity, courage, and a relentless drive to make a difference. At EIT, you'll join a community built on excellence, innovation, tenacity, trust, and collaboration, where bold ideas become real-world breakthroughs. Together, we push boundaries, embrace complexity, and create solutions to scale ideas from lab to society. Explore more at .

**Welcome to the Generative Biology Institute:**

Led by Founding Director Jason Chin, the Generative Biology Institute (GBI) at the Ellison Institute of Technology is tackling the key challenges in making biology engineerable, and thereby unlocking the unrivalled power of biology for the benefit of humanity.

The vision of the GBI is to lay the foundations for engineering biology, and unlock its potential for good. To achieve this, we must overcome two key challenges. First, we need the ability to write in the natural language of biology, enabling the rapid and scalable synthesis of entire genomes with precision. Second, we must understand what to write - determining which DNA sequences will generate biological systems that perform the desired functions. Addressing these challenges will allow us to harness the full power of biology to create transformative solutions across health, agriculture, clean energy and more.

GBI will have sustained and substantial funding to support the unique scale and ambition of its ground-breaking vision for engineering biology. GBI researchers will also be supported by cutting-edge technology hubs including mass spectrometry, flow cytometry, sequencing, automation, imaging, and bioprocessing. GBI will also have access to substantial compute resources that can be leveraged to further accelerate progress, including scientific compute, bioinformatics, and machine learning. The environment at GBI will allow researchers to undertake ambitious, long-term, collaborative research, and we will actively support the translation of research to commercial applications, where appropriate.

The Generative Biology Institute commenced operations in 2025, occupying newly renovated bespoke space in the Oxford Science Park. The team will later move to a purpose-made facility in the Oxford Science Park, currently under construction. Once complete, this state-of-the-art facility will include more than 40,000 m^2 of research laboratory and office space. It will house over 30 groups and up to 600 employees at scale, focused on solving the two critical challenges in making biology engineerable and applying the solutions to addressing the global challenges encapsulated in EIT's Humane Endeavors.

**Your Role:**

The Mass Spectrometry Tech Hub within the GBI is seeking a Scientist / Senior Scientist with expertise in single-cell mass spectrometry, with a particular focus on single-cell proteomics and/or metabolomics.

This is an exciting opportunity to help establish and develop cutting-edge single-cell MS workflows within a highly collaborative, technology-driven research institute. The successful candidate will work closely with GBI research groups as well as scientists across other EIT institutes. We also work in close collaboration with other Tech Hubs including automation, flow cytometry, sequencing, bioinformatics, scientific computing and AI/ML, to deliver high-quality, reproducible and scalable analytical workflows.

We are looking for candidates with a good understanding of the challenges of low-input and single-cell analysis, that can communicate clearly with multidisciplinary teams, can develop robust experimental workflows, and are motivated to push the boundaries of what mass spectrometry can deliver.

This role is particularly suited to a scientist who enjoys developing new methods, troubleshooting complex analytical workflows, working across biological applications, and translating advanced MS technologies into accessible, high-impact research capability for the wider Institute.

**Key Responsibilities**

* To develop, implement and optimise LC-MS-based workflows for low-input and single-cell proteomics and/or metabolomics.
* To support GBI, and broader EIT, researchers in the design, execution, analysis and interpretation of mass spectrometry experiments, including sample preparation, method development, data acquisition and data interpretation.
* To help develop standard operating procedures, training material and user-facing guidance for single-cell and low-input MS workflows.
* To contribute to the analysis and interpretation of complex MS datasets, working closely with bioinformatics, scientific computing and AI/ML colleagues where appropriate.
* To assist, where required, in manuscript preparation, internal reports and external presentations.
* To promote and champion EIT and the work of the GBI, representing the Institute at scientific meetings, conferences and public events where appropriate.

## Requirements

**Essential Criteria**

* PhD, equivalent advanced degree, or equivalent research/industry experience in analytical chemistry, mass spectrometry, proteomics, metabolomics, biochemistry, molecular biology, cell biology or a related discipline.
* Demonstrable experience in mass spectrometry-based proteomics and/or metabolomics, including LC-MS sample preparation, method development, data acquisition, troubleshooting and quality control.
* Strong knowledge of low-input or single-cell analytical workflows, including single-cell proteomics, single-cell metabolomics, low-cell-number proteomics or other high-sensitivity MS approaches.
* Practical understanding of bottom-up and top-down proteomics and/or metabolomics workflows, including LC-MS acquisition strategies, database searching, quantitative analysis and interpretation of complex datasets.
* Experience with MS data analysis software such as Spectronaut, DIA-NN, MaxQuant, Proteome Discoverer, FragPipe, Compound Discoverer, MS-DIAL, Skyline or equivalent platforms.
* Strong communication, collaboration and organisational skills, with a commitment to experimental reproducibility, data integrity and working effectively across multidisciplinary research teams.

**Desirable Experience**

* Hands-on experience with advanced high-resolution MS platforms, including Orbitrap Tribrid instruments and/or timsTOF platforms.
* Experience with nanoLC, low-flow LC, high-sensitivity chromatography, carrier proteome approaches, TMT/isobaric labelling, DIA, DDA, PRM, SRM/MRM or related quantitative MS workflows.
* Experience developing or implementing single-cell or ultra-low-input workflows such as nanoPOTS, SCoPE-MS, plexDIA, low-input DIA, FACS-based sample preparation or automated nanolitre-scale sample preparation.
* Experience working with limited or complex biological samples, including rare cell populations, sorted cells, micro-dissected material, primary cells, tissue-derived samples, organoids, microbial systems, plant samples or engineered biological systems.
* Experience integrating MS workflows with upstream biological or automation platforms, including cell culture, cell sorting, liquid handlers, acoustic dispensing, microfluidics or high-throughput sample preparation.
* Experience working in a technology hub, core facility, collaborative research environment, biotech, pharma or translational setting; for Senior Scientist level, evidence of independent method development,

Within this ecosystem, the Pathogen Mission exemplifies EIT's commitment to transformative science. It aims to revolutionise the diagnosis and treatment of infectious diseases by leveraging whole genome sequencing (WGS)-based metagenomic and pathogen-specific analytical tools. This remit includes the development of a decentralised, sample-to-answer sequencing diagnostic platform for infectious diseases, enabling rapid and accurate analysis of patient samples without prior assumptions. Supported by Oracle Inc.'s cloud-computing scale and security infrastructure, the Pathogen Mission is progressing towards certified diagnostic products for deployment in laboratories, hospitals, and public health organisations worldwide.

**Your Role**

We're seeking an experienced and innovative **Senior MEMS Development Engineer** to develop novel microfabricated devices and sensor interfaces for next-generation nanopore sequencing technologies.

This hands-on role will focus on designing, prototyping, and characterising MEMS devices, taking concepts from proof-of-concept through to integrated multi-channel sensing systems. Working closely with a Senior Electronics R&D Engineer, you'll drive device development through iterative design, testing, and optimisation.

You'll tackle challenges spanning microfabrication, materials, device architecture, and MEMS-electronics integration while collaborating with external fabrication partners and technical suppliers. As the programme grows, you'll help establish the MEMS engineering capabilities, processes, and technical foundations needed to support a wider multidisciplinary team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Take technical ownership of the MEMS engineering development of novel microfabricated sensing structures and device interfaces, from early concepts through to functional prototypes and integrated systems.
* Design and develop microfabricated devices and test structures, including the selection of materials, fabrication processes and device geometries.
* Develop and evaluate fabrication approaches using established semiconductor and MEMS manufacturing techniques, adapting processes to meet the requirements of novel sensing devices.
* Work closely with the Senior Electrical R&D Engineer to co-develop and evaluate prototype devices, using experimental findings to guide iterative improvements in MEMS design and electronic integration.
* Design and characterise mechanical, electrical and material interfaces, investigating their influence on device performance, reliability and repeatability.
* Develop experimental methods and test structures to assess fabrication quality, dimensional accuracy, device performance and reliability.
* Investigate the effects of materials, surface properties, fabrication tolerances and assembly processes on device behaviour and performance.
* Collaborate with electrical and mechanical engineers to develop prototype assemblies, alignment methods and experimental test platforms.
* Identify and resolve fabrication challenges through design iteration, experimental characterisation and failure analysis.
* Develop increasingly sophisticated prototype devices as the project progresses, supporting the transition from initial feasibility studies to integrated nanopore sensing systems.
* Identify and engage specialist external fabrication facilities, engineering suppliers and technical collaborators to support the development and manufacture of prototype components and devices.
* Define technical specifications and fabrication requirements for external suppliers, including design documentation, material requirements, dimensional tolerances and performance criteria.

**Join us at EIT:**

**Your Role:**

We are seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented **Payroll Administrator** to support the Payroll Manager in delivering accurate and timely payroll and benefits administration. As the second member of the payroll team, the role will work under the direction of the Payroll Manager, with a strong emphasis on payroll and benefits administration, volume data input, data accuracy, record checking and pre-payroll processing audit support. The role will act as the second point of contact for payroll queries, support resolving routine enquiries within agreed procedures and escalating complex matters to the Payroll Manager.

EIT currently works with a third-party payroll provider to deliver payroll services to employees. Over the next 12-24 months, payroll records and data are expected to move to Oracle Fusion, with the potential to transition to in-house payroll processing. Under the direction of the Payroll Manager, the Payroll Administrator will support these workstreams through data preparation, cleansing, validation, testing and administrative support.

**Your Responsibilities:**

**Payroll Administration and Data Input**

* Support the Payroll Manager with the monthly payroll cycle by collecting, checking and entering payroll data accurately and within agreed cut-off dates.
* Prepare payroll input files and supporting documentation for review by the Payroll Manager and liaise with the third-party payroll provider on routine data queries under their direction.
* Input and update authorised payroll changes, including new starters, leavers, salary changes, bank details, variable payments, absence information and deductions, checking effective dates and supporting approvals.
* Act as the second point of contact for payroll queries, provide routine information and track enquiries through to resolution, escalating discrepancies and complex queries to the Payroll Manager.
* Maintain complete and accurate payroll records, ensuring each amendment is supported by the required documentation and a clear audit trail.
* Support payroll-related communications, including payslip queries, pay changes and payment notifications, using approved information and templates.
* Prepare routine payroll reports, spreadsheets and data extracts for review by the Payroll Manager and use by HR and Finance.
* Support the administration of statutory payments, pension contributions and payroll deductions in line with established procedures, referring technical or compliance questions to the Payroll Manager.
* Maintain payroll calendars, checklists and action logs, follow up missing information and flag any issues that may affect payroll deadlines.

**Data Accuracy Checking and Audit Support**

* Check payroll inputs against HR records and source documents, including names, employee numbers, amounts, payment details and effective dates; seek clarification before processing incomplete or inconsistent information.
* Carry out regular data audits and checks for missing records, duplicate entries and discrepancies between HR, payroll, pension and benefit datasets.
* Support monthly payroll reconciliations and pre-payroll checks by comparing current and previous payroll data, investigating routine differences and presenting exceptions to the Payroll Manager for review.

**Payroll Related Benefits Administration**

* Support the Payroll Manager with the payroll administration and enrolment processes of employee benefits, including taxable benefits, salary sacrifice arrangements and associated deductions.
* Collect, enter and check benefit and pension data against approved records and provider information, highlighting missing information or discrepancies.
