# Head of AI, Game Generation

## About Nanogram

Nanogram is a TikTok-style mobile feed where every item is a short, AI-generated browser game. Anyone can make one from a prompt. We're a venture-backed startup with our core engineering team in Sofia.

## The role

The game-generation pipeline is the product. Every game in the feed comes out of it: a creator's prompt goes through intent extraction, template matching, model routing, asset retrieval, generation, validation and repair, and finally the runtime that plays it.

You'll lead the team that builds and runs this system and own its design. You set the architecture, the roadmap and the evaluation strategy, and decide where models, templates and code each do the work. The team is measured on two numbers: playability pass rate going up and cost per generation going down, at volume.

This is a leadership and system-design role. Your time goes to architecture, technical direction, prioritisation, reviews and hiring. You should be able to prototype an idea or read through a failing generation trace yourself, but you won't be writing production code day to day.

## What you'll do

* Lead the AI team (ML/data engineering, game development and a contracted engineering partner): set priorities, run planning, unblock people, and grow the team as we scale.
* Own the architecture of the generation pipeline end to end and decide how it evolves.
* Define how we measure quality: benchmark suites, LLM-as-judge and playability pass/fail checks, and use them to show output improving over time.
* Design the feedback loop that brings play data (completion, replay, shares, remixes) back into generation.
* Own the economics: model selection and tiered routing, templates and retrieval, caching, and when distillation or fine-tuning is worth it.
* Work with product, game design and core engineering to turn what creators and players need into a technical roadmap.
* Keep us current on models and tooling, and make the call on what to adopt.

## What you bring

* Have led an engineering team that shipped an LLM-powered generation system to production at real volume.
* Have designed multi-stage generation systems with evaluation built in: generation, validation, repair and eval, and the feedback loop between them.
* Understand the cost side well: you've made model routing, caching and template/retrieval decisions that materially cut cost per generation while holding quality.
* Technical enough to hold your own in architecture and code reviews, and to prototype when it's the fastest way to settle a question.
* Comfortable making product trade-offs as well as technical ones.
* **Optional but highly recommended:** experience in games. You've shipped games, worked at a games studio, or built tooling or content systems for games, and you know what makes a short game fun to play.

## Nice to have

* Experience with code generation or prompt-to-app systems.
* Hands-on work with game engines or web game frameworks (Unity, Godot, Phaser, Three.js), or procedural content generation.
* Fine-tuning or distilling open models in production.
* Image or asset generation experience.
* Startup or founding-team experience, or having built a team from a small base.

## Hiring process

1. CV
2. Intro call with a founder (30 min)
3. System design interview (90 min)
4. Leadership and team interview (1 hour)

* **Type:** Full-time.
* **Compensation:** £120,000-£150,000 gross per year plus equity.
* **Visa sponsorship:** we're unable to sponsor UK visas at present, so you'll need the right to work in the UK.

Success is measured by how well we use our GPUs: keeping production reliable and improving the performance of our training and serving stack.

* Running Kubernetes clusters for GPU training and inference
* Improving how GPU work is scheduled and placed
* Detecting, draining and repairing unhealthy GPU nodes

By month 3, you’ll be handling a share of cluster incidents on your own and will have shipped one change to scheduling or node health, such as automatically detecting and draining unhealthy GPU nodes. By month 6, you’ll own one part of the compute layer outright: scheduling and placement, node health and repair, or capacity and new regions. By month 12, you’ll be responsible for a globally distributed GPU system that shifts capacity between training and inference as needs change.

## Who you’ll work with

Your hiring manager is our VP of Engineering. Day to day, you’ll work with the Platform Infrastructure team, the research and product teams who use our compute, and our cloud providers and other vendors.

**You’re likely a good fit if you:**

* Have built and run GPU workloads on Kubernetes
* Could design a GPU cluster for training and online RL from scratch
* Debug confidently at the OS layer and below (Linux, GPU drivers, networking and storage)
* Write strong Python

* Slurm
* Kubernetes scheduling and autoscaling tools such as Kueue or Karpenter
* Multi-cloud orchestration tools such as SkyPilot

* Terraform

Four stages, about three hours in total: a 30-minute call with our Talent team, a 60-minute coding interview, a 60-minute system design interview and a closing 30-minute conversation with our VP of Engineering. Senior Privacy Consultant / Data Protection Officer
Remote
Harper James is growing its data protection team. We’re looking for an experienced privacy professional to help deliver our outsourced DPO service and support ambitious businesses with their day-to-day data protection needs.
You’ll manage client relationships, provide practical advice and help businesses put effective privacy processes into practice. You do not need to be a qualified solicitor or hold a law degree to apply.
About Harper James
We’re a national commercial law firm supporting entrepreneurial businesses throughout their growth. Our approach combines experienced people, accessible advice and flexible ways of working.
Our data protection service helps clients understand their responsibilities and manage risk in a way that works for their business. You’ll work alongside our specialist solicitors, bringing your own experience of managing privacy programmes and delivering ongoing support.
Remote working
You’ll work remotely as part of a connected and supportive team, with access to our regional meeting spaces.
We share knowledge, work together on client matters and make time to build relationships with colleagues. You’ll have the flexibility to organise your work responsibly, with support available when you need it.
What we’re looking for
You’ll have substantial experience in data protection, typically gained over five or more years, and a track record of taking responsibility for a privacy programme or a portfolio of clients.
Your background might be in an outsourced DPO service, privacy consultancy, an in-house data protection team or information governance. We’re interested in the experience and judgement you bring, and your ability to help clients make progress.
You’ll be confident in areas including:
Assessing privacy compliance, identifying gaps and developing practical improvement plans.
Advising on data protection impact assessments and monitoring resulting actions.
Maintaining records of processing, privacy notices, policies and retention schedules.
Supporting data subject access requests and other individual rights requests.
Assessing suppliers, data-sharing arrangements and international transfers.
Supporting breach assessment, incident response and engagement with regulators.
Delivering training and explaining data protection requirements to different audiences.
You’ll have a strong working knowledge of UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act and PECR, alongside an understanding of relevant European requirements. Experience of AI governance or technology projects would also be valuable.
A qualification such as CIPP/E, CIPM or an equivalent is desirable. We place particular value on evidence that you can apply your knowledge effectively.
Your role
You’ll become a trusted point of contact for a portfolio of clients, acting as their appointed DPO where appropriate and helping them maintain an effective privacy programme.
That means understanding each business, agreeing priorities, reviewing progress and providing clear advice when questions arise. You’ll be comfortable working with founders, senior managers, HR and IT teams, and constructively challenging decisions where necessary.
You’ll manage competing demands, maintain clear records and recognise when specialist legal or technical input is needed. Our data protection solicitors will work alongside you on complex legal issues, and you’ll help develop our processes and resources as the service grows.
The Harper James difference
We give people responsibility and trust them to deliver. You’ll be supported by colleagues who share their expertise and value straightforward communication.
You’ll enjoy working here if you:
Take ownership and follow through on commitments.
Explain complex issues clearly and without unnecessary jargon.
Balance commercial understanding with sound professional judgement.
Work confidently with Microsoft 365 and learn new systems readily.
Explore responsible ways to use technology and AI to improve your work.
Contribute to a friendly team where people support each other.
What we offer
A competitive salary.
Flexible remote working.
33 days’ annual leave, including public holidays, with the option to purchase up to five additional days.
Private healthcare and life assurance.
Access to our electric vehicle scheme.
Varied work with growing businesses and the opportunity to help shape our expanding privacy service.
NO AGENCIES PLEASE

## Who we are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 

## The role

As a Talent Operations Partner based in Munich, you will work closely with the wider Talent Operations team to support the scheduling engine that keeps our hiring pipelines moving at pace. Interviews span multiple time zones, high volumes of candidates, and fast-moving hiring loops, and you will help turn that complexity into a smooth, well-coordinated process. Your work directly shapes the candidate experience and the speed at which specialists join the teams building our technological advantage in defence AI. By bringing precision and structure to high-volume, multi-region scheduling, you will make a tangible and measurable contribution to how quickly and effectively we secure the talent we need.

## The day-to-day

* Support high-volume interview scheduling across multiple time zones, working with the wider Talent Operations team to balance candidate, interviewer, and hiring manager availability at pace
* Operate Applicant Tracking Systems and automated scheduling tools to manage complex, fast-moving interview loops for virtual and onsite candidates
* Act as a key point of contact for candidates and interviewers, ensuring rapid response times and a seamless experience
* Maintain accurate, real-time data, documentation, and templates across all internal systems to support quick decision-making
* Partner with Talent Acquisition and Talent Operations colleagues to identify scheduling bottlenecks and implement measurable improvements to throughput and turnaround time
* Contribute to reporting on scheduling speed, pipeline velocity, and interview completion rates to track operational performance
* Be based in our Munich or London office, minimum 3 days per week

## You should apply if you

* Have supported a scaling, high-volume talent acquisition function with a focus on operational execution
* Manage complex, multi-time-zone scheduling with precision, even when priorities shift quickly
* Communicate clearly and can articulate process challenges to propose practical, fast-turnaround solutions
* Use Applicant Tracking Systems proficiently to increase team efficiency and throughput
* Solve problems in the moment to keep fast-paced pipelines moving without losing accuracy
* Are business fluent in German and English, and adapt effectively to a scaling, high-volume environment while maintaining confidentiality

*Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically* *under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.*

## Nice to Have

* Operational experience using Greenhouse, Ashby, Confluence, and GoodTime
* Data-focused approach, with the ability to manage and interpret reports relating to process efficiency

## Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields

* Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns
* The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world
* Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward
* In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts
* We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

Here at Humanoid, we believe in a future where robots amplify human potential. That’s why we’ve set out on a mission to build the world’s most capable, commercially-scalable, and safe humanoid robots. We’re bringing that mission to life with HMND‐01 - our rapidly developed humanoid platform being deployed in real industrial environments - and we’re growing the team to take it even further.

**About the role:**  
At Humanoid, we are working from a simple hypothesis that AI is rapidly transforming engineering. The bottlenecks are shifting from writing code to how efficiently AI-authored changes can be verified.

We’re looking for an Engineering Lead to own developer productivity in the age of AI and agents. You’ll build the platform that lets our engineers move faster with coding agents while protecting our code, infrastructure, and robots. You’ll give developers and agents the environments, context, and tools to work effectively, and build verification and security into the path from task to healthy deployment. This means rethinking how engineering work gets done, not just adding agents to existing processes, and establishing the access controls, isolation, and monitoring needed to guard against mistakes, misuse, and new security threats.

This is a hands-on leadership role and the keystone hire for a new developer productivity team. You’ll build the critical systems yourself, recruit and lead engineers, and work across Developer Tools, Security, Safety, Simulation, and robot software. Success means increasing engineering output while reducing cost and human review per accepted change, without increasing defects or safety risk.  
  
**What you'll do:**

* Own the path from an agent task to a healthy deployed change, including acceptance criteria, execution, verification, merge, rollout, monitoring, and rollback.
* Build secure, reproducible agent runtimes with task-scoped identity, short-lived credentials, bounded access, cost controls, and re-playable execution records. Proactively detect unauthorized agent activity across our compute clusters, whether internal or external.
* Build the interfaces developers use to launch, monitor, and control agents, alongside tooling for agents to collaborate through shared memory, coordinated work, and appropriately authorized access to company resources.
* Reduce the tokens and retries required for accepted work through better context assembly, model and tool routing, caching, task decomposition, and feedback.
* Give agents fast access to builds, tests, simulation, replay, and hardware-in-the-loop, with acceptance criteria they cannot alter.
* Work with engineering teams to make the codebase easier to navigate and verify through clear interfaces, strong invariants, reproducible environments, fast local checks, and well-documented implementation paths.
* Recruit and lead the team while remaining hands-on. Measure success through cost per accepted change, human review time, escaped defects, and time from push to healthy on the robot.

**What we're looking for:**

* Experience building and operating developer tooling or infrastructure used across engineering teams, such as build systems, CI/CD, test infrastructure, deployment pipelines, or internal platforms.
* Strong software engineering skills and comfort working in large codebases or monorepos.
* Practical experience with Linux, containers, and cloud infrastructure, plus working knowledge of Kubernetes.
* Hands-on experience using and integrating coding agents into real engineering workflows. You understand how context, tools, and evals affect reliability, latency, and cost, and can talk concretely about what worked and what didn’t.
* Sound security judgment around workload isolation, identity, permissions, and credentials. You can design appropriate boundaries for agents accessing code, infrastructure, and company resources.
* Experience building reliable automated tests or verification systems and diagnosing failures across code, tooling, and infrastructure. You have good judgment about what automated checks establish and where human review still matters.
* Experience leading engineers while remaining hands-on. You can set technical direction, recruit a strong team, and turn an ambitious goal into systems that engineers use and trust.

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive equity: stock options with meaningful upside as we scale.
* 30+ paid days off, including 23 days of annual leave, all UK bank holidays, and additional company closure days (including Christmas–New Year shutdown).
* Private healthcare, including virtual and in-person care.
* Pension scheme with 8% total contribution (5% employee, 3% employer) on full earnings.
* Free daily breakfast, catered lunch, and snacks in-office.
* Work at the frontier - collaborate daily with world-class engineers, researchers, and product experts building the next generation of AI and humanoid robotics.
* Real ownership - direct access to founding leadership, meaningful input on product direction, and the ability to drive key initiatives from day one.

Corporate cost growth held below revenue growth, supporting EBITDAC margin.

Monthly reviews focus on drivers and decisions; benchmarks and cost-per-employee views in routine use.

Clear performance expectations, stronger analytical output and a team the executives value.

Dark Peak Analytics

Dark Peak Analytics is a specialist health economics modelling and software development consultancy. We combine scientific expertise, advanced analytical methods and technology-enabled solutions to support evidence-based healthcare decision-making.

Our team works with pharmaceutical and healthcare organisations to develop bespoke health economic models, decision-support platforms and analytical tools. Dark Peak is now part of a wider organisation with Initiate Consultancy, creating opportunities to collaborate across health economics and outcomes research, health technology assessment, market access, evidence generation and analytics.

We are a small, highly technical and collaborative team. This is an exciting opportunity to join Dark Peak as we continue to grow our team, technology and client offering.

We are seeking a Senior Health Economist / Data Scientist to support the development of health economic models, analytical platforms and software for health economics and outcomes research.

This role is ideal for a candidate with a strong quantitative background, excellent R / C++ programming skills and an interest in applying software development approaches to complex healthcare questions.

You will work on fast-paced client projects, contribute to the development of health economic modelling platforms in R and Shiny, and help create practical, robust and transparent tools that support evidence-based healthcare decisions. * Support the development of cost-effectiveness and budget-impact models for health technologies.
* Contribute to model conceptualisation, implementation, validation and troubleshooting.
* Conduct analyses of healthcare, clinical trial and other relevant data.
* Critically review model structures, inputs, assumptions and outputs.
* Support the adaptation of economic models to meet local market and decision-maker requirements.
* Produce clear, reproducible and well-documented code, collaborating using Git and GitHub.
* Contribute to testing, quality assurance and technical review processes.

Research, Innovation and Teaching

* Maintain awareness of developments in health economics, data science, statistical programming and HEOR software development.

**Location:** London, United Kingdom.

**Contract:** Freelance, with the possibility of future full-time employment.

### About the job:

AI is forcing engineers to evolve like never before. The role is increasingly defined by deciding what a system should do and which specs and evals to write, then handing execution to agents and carefully checking what comes back. The best engineers we know still understand every layer underneath and are eager to spend more time thinking about how and why the solutions they build get used.

That's who we want to work with at Calibr, a startup founded by and, and part of The Apprentify Group, one of the UK's leading AI and tech training providers. We build tailored AI solutions for companies going through AI transformation, then help their teams build the skills to run, extend and own those systems themselves. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you'll work directly with clients to scope the problem, build the solution and leave them more capable than when you arrived.

### Who we are:

Our mission at Calibr is to help companies build in-house AI capability. Our approach is simple: help businesses identify where AI can create the most value, prove it in a focused part of the business and build the capability to navigate AI adoption long term.

We are industry-agnostic and work with the UK's leading SMEs, scale-ups, corporates, NGOs and public sector organisations. Our group's clients include Jet2, JD Group, Canon, BBC, B&Q, McLaren and Manchester Airport, to name a few.

The Apprentify Group is a collective of six specialist businesses, including Netcom Training, Flourish, Ioda, The Juice Academy and Apprentify. We are united by a shared commitment to providing learning opportunities to people at every stage of their career, and in 2025 we were named the UK's 30th-fastest-growing private company by The Sunday Times.

### **Who we are looking for:**

We are looking for a technically competent orchestrator (i.e. someone who can explain the decisions behind their code and develop it in ways that respect wider architectures) to help build transformation projects for clients.

Your goals will be to turn a scoped business problem into well-bounded technical compositions, build tested and evaluated guardrails, and create feedback loops that involve humans, resulting in AI-assisted delivery that is efficient yet explainable and trustworthy.

#### What you will do

* Decompose ambiguous problems into smaller components and map out their dependencies and operational risk before production.
* Determine the right set of tools (harnesses, models, custom tools and MCP servers).
* Code the underlying plumbing and necessary automations to enable the design of the system while embedding it in a pre-existing architecture.
* Build observability channels to monitor the health of the system and allow for user-accessible fixes.
* Bound your builds with schemas, evaluation sets and permissions for human review to enable transparency.
* Explain architecture decisions, their trade-offs and risks in terms non-technical stakeholders can act on.

#### What you bring

We understand that this is a new and emerging role, so we focus far more on the signals we receive from you as a candidate than on the job title on your CV. You are, however, likely to be a match if you have demonstrable competence in the following areas:

* Building stress-tested cloud systems that have made it to production and had measurable impact (3+ years).
* Shipping AI harnesses involving RAG, document intelligence and custom tools, with a focus on evaluation pipelines, model routing, and agent/tool orchestration and permissions.
* Working with Python (including FastAPI), specifically LangChain (and LangGraph where necessary), SQL and scalable (vector) databases.
* Enforcing rigorous evaluation to cover edge cases and determine specific mitigations for prompt injection and tool abuse.
* Distinguishing a model safety issue from an application security issue.

***Travel:*** *This role may require being on-site with clients.*

### How we work:

As part of The Apprentify Group, we have the backing, client relationships and commercial experience of a group that has already scaled several businesses. You get the pace and ownership of an early-stage startup with a stable foundation behind it.

As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you'll work directly with the founders, our fractional CTO and, where needed, our clients. We want you to have a real say in how we build, from the tools we standardise on to how we run client projects.

We know that the people who join us at this stage will shape what Calibr's engineering practice looks like for years. Culture is important to us, and we look for people who thrive in work environments that value:

* **Infectious Ambition.** We believe every high-agency person should have a "why" that sustains them and motivates others to strive for greatness as a team.
* **Efficient Conscientiousness.** We care about the details but move fast. Finding the balance between depth and iteration is essential to how we build.
* **Radical Kindness.** Being kind is more than being nice. For us, radical kindness requires the courage to be honest, even when it causes discomfort and disruption.

If we think you're a good fit, we'll invite you to a technical interview, where you'll demonstrate your capabilities by walking us through a project of your choice. You'll be evaluated not only on your ability to build efficient systems but also on how well you can explain and defend the system you built.

##### Job Description

We’re looking for an analytical, hands-on client success leader to own our client relationships and lead implementations from kickoff through go-live and beyond. You’ll be the trusted partner for institutional clients, lead complex onboarding projects, and drive retention and growth across your accounts. You’ll also help build how client success works at KOR. If you have deep experience in OTC derivatives or regulatory reporting, like being close to the detail as well as the relationship, and use modern tools (including AI) to scale what you do, this role is for you. We’ll hire at Manager or Director level depending on experience.

We are a VC backed fintech with a live product in the regulatory trade reporting space and growing list of institutional clients. If you want to join a scale-up that is going to provide growth and ownership, keep reading.

KOR is a company built on leading edge cloud technology built by industry domain experts and world class in-house engineering. We’re solving the most challenging problems around by bringing fresh designs and solutions to data utility, quality, and processing inefficiencies... while unlocking insane value for clients.

Teamwork and laser focus are central to everything we do at KOR. With the right support, we believe small independent teams with deep expertises achieve better results and encourage skilled people to take responsibility and grow their careers. We live by the mantra of work humble, work smart, and work together.

#### What you’ll do

* Own a portfolio of institutional client relationships across EMEA/UK, from operations teams up to senior stakeholders
* Lead client implementations end to end: scoping, planning, coordinating with our engineering team, test cycles and go-live
* Be the senior escalation point, working through complex reporting, data and regulatory issues with clients
* Drive retention, renewals and account growth, and partner with sales on expansion and new client pre-sales
* Define and improve client success processes: onboarding playbooks, health scoring, QBRs and escalation paths
* Use AI and automation to scale the team’s work and lift the client experience
* Bring client and regulatory insight back into product priorities and KOR working groups
* Visit clients on-site for kickoffs, go-lives, executive meetings and relationship reviews
* Director level: lead and grow the EMEA/UK client success team, including coaching analysts, and own CS metrics and reporting to leadership

##### Job Requirements

#### **About you**

You’re analytical, client-facing and hands-on. You like to understand how things work, you’re comfortable going deep into data, and you take ownership of outcomes. You see AI and modern tooling as a way to do better work faster, not a novelty.

* 6+ years in OTC derivatives or regulatory reporting, with significant client-facing or implementation experience (Director: 10+ years, including leading people or a function)
* Strong working knowledge of EMEA/UK regimes (EMIR, REMIT, MIFID), with exposure to CFTC, SEC, CSA, ASIC or MAS as a plus
* Proven track record leading complex implementations for institutional clients
* Experience owning client relationships, renewals and account growth
* Analytical and comfortable with data: able to diagnose an issue yourself before escalating
* Already using AI tools in your daily work and keen to shape how a team uses them
* Excellent communicator, from technical teams to executives
* Based in EMEA/UK region and happy to travel to clients regularly (around 10–20%)
* Nice to have: SQL, APIs/JSON, ISO 20022 or FpML, experience at a reporting vendor or trade repository, experience building a CS function at a scale-up

At KOR, company culture and fit to it is everything to us. We are looking for an open-minded, humble, driven, communicative, team-player to join us.

#### **What we have to offer**

* Fully remote
* A culture of trust, ownership and constructive feedback
* Competitive salary
* A modern tool stack, including AI, and room to shape how we use it
* A span of control that matches your ambitions and skills
* Tell us what else matters to you

Beyond the package, we’re committed to a working relationship that runs both ways. We’ll listen, take your needs and goals seriously, and invest in your professional growth. If you want room to grow at a company that values your work and backs your ambitions, we’d like to hear from you.

At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.

Kpler is expanding into high-value maritime verticals, with Cruise Liners and Port Operations representing two important opportunities. Both address a common market need: the lack of independent, reliable insights into actual performance, built on observed data rather than published schedules or self-reported information.

In the cruise sector, operators and analysts often rely on published itineraries rather than actual vessel movements, despite the significant fuel and carbon costs associated with fleet operations. In ports, performance data is often incomplete or self-reported, creating a need for independent benchmarking as berth-level emissions carry increasing financial implications under schemes such as the EU ETS.

As a Senior Product Manager, Cruise Liners & Port Operations, you will own both products end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to the first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build two early-stage products in parallel, leveraging Kpler’s network of more than 13,000 AIS receivers and over 10,000 mapped ports and berths.

For Cruise Liners, you will develop itinerary intelligence for tracked fleets, providing an independent view of actual sailed itineraries, fuel consumption and emissions. For Port Operations, you will build a product focused on port-level vessel activity monitoring, giving port authorities a reliable, live view of activity and performance.

This is an individual-contributor role for an experienced product professional with a background in maritime, cruise, travel, ports or an adjacent B2B data/SaaS environment. You will need to balance competing priorities across two products, establish trusted data methodologies, engage customers and bring both products to market through a pragmatic, build-and-iterate approach.

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for Cruise Liners and Port Operations, prioritising customer needs and commercial opportunities while making trade-offs between the two products explicit.

* Collaborate with Engineering, Data, Sales, Product Marketing and other product teams to align delivery, reuse shared data and emissions capabilities, and develop early data and distribution partnerships.
* Define the Cruise Liners product direction, delivering fleet itinerary intelligence based on live, observed vessel movements that reflects actual sailed journeys rather than published schedules.
* Build the Port Operations product, providing port authorities with a reliable, live view of vessel activity using Kpler’s AIS receiver network and mapped port and berth data.
* Develop product positioning and competitive strategy, identifying opportunities to differentiate Kpler’s independent, first-party observed data from existing cruise analytics and port operations offerings.
* Drive go-to-market execution for both products, working with Product Marketing on positioning, packaging, pricing input and launch planning, and establishing repeatable customer discovery and design partnerships.

### Skills & Experience

* 6–10 years of senior product or commercial experience in maritime data, cruise or travel, ports, or an adjacent B2B data/SaaS business, with a proven track record of delivering products that customers adopt.
* Working fluency in at least one of cruise or port operations, with the ability to develop expertise quickly in the other.
* Direct experience in the cruise or ports industry, with an established network among operators, port authorities and terminals.
* Experience translating customer needs into product strategy and working closely with product and engineering teams to deliver solutions.
* Experience managing multiple products or workstreams simultaneously, balancing competing priorities and maintaining delivery momentum.
* Strong product discovery and roadmap prioritisation skills, with the ability to engage customers and translate market insights into actionable product requirements.
* Experience working with data and engineering teams to deliver data-driven products.

**Build the AI therapist that delivers end-to-end CBT to patients in the US: live, clinically supervised, and measured on whether people actually get better.**

**About Limbic**

Limbic’s vision is to ensure the highest quality therapy is accessible to everyone, everywhere.

Limbic has supported more than 820,000 patients across the UK and the US. We are used in over 50% of NHS Talking Therapies services, which makes us the largest-ever deployment of generative AI for direct patient care, and our AI now delivers end-to-end therapy to patients in the US under the supervision of licensed clinicians.

Safety and science come first. We are the only AI mental health chatbot with UKCA Class IIa medical device certification, and the first AI-led mental healthcare company selected for the FDA’s TEMPO pilot. Our results are published in leading scientific journals: in a randomised, double-blind trial published in Nature Medicine, our AI agents scored higher than licensed CBT therapists on a standard measure of therapy skill.

**The Role**

As an AI/ML Engineer, you will sit at the intersection of computational psychiatry, clinical science, and software engineering. You will join the product team building our AI therapist: a voice agent that delivers structured, evidence-based CBT over the phone to adults with depression and anxiety, with licensed clinicians overseeing every patient’s care.

The product is live and growing week on week, so your work reaches real patients quickly. You will own problems end to end: frame them with clinicians and product managers, ship a change, measure whether it helped, and iterate. Our AI products are built on shared platforms for agents, evaluation and safety, so what you build here is reused across Limbic.

**What You’ll Do**

* Improve how our AI therapist runs sessions, from session structure and case formulation to therapeutic techniques and continuity across a course of treatment, working closely with clinicians.
* Strengthen the safety systems that protect patients in real time, including risk detection and how the agent responds when risk is disclosed.
* Build evaluations and LLM-as-judge autolabellers, validated against clinician labels, so we know quickly and reliably whether a change made care better or worse.
* Make voice conversations feel natural: responsive, well-paced, and able to recover gracefully when a conversation goes off script.
* Help patients stay with their treatment long enough to recover, through AI features such as well-timed session reminders and clear expectations about what therapy involves, and test what works with experiments.
* Optimise how we collect outcome measures such as PHQ-9 and GAD-7, including the methods, timing and predictive modelling of recovery.
* Ship changes safely through incremental rollouts, automated testing and a clinical sign-off process built for a regulated medical device.

**What You’ll Bring**

* You must meet one of the following educational and experience backgrounds:

  + A PhD in Computational Psychiatry or a related field, coupled with demonstrated industry experience in Data Science, Product, or ML engineering.
  + **OR** A BSc/MSc in a Computational Psychiatry related field (research focus) plus 2 years of experience in ML engineering or Data Science within an Engineering/Product Development environment.
* Proficiency in either Python or TypeScript/JavaScript.
* Experience building LLM-powered features and a track record of eval-driven development.
* An expert approach to hypothesis-driven work, with a track record of balancing product development with scientific rigour.
* Experience using Machine Learning in a production environment or via high-impact scientific publications (e.g., predictive modelling, reinforcement learning).
* Experience modelling text/language data, including building LLM classifiers and using vector-based methods.
* Experience modelling longitudinal data and working with databases (SQL or NoSQL).
* A strong understanding of evidence-based mental health care (such as Cognitive Behavioural Therapy) and a deep interest in the causal mechanisms that drive therapeutic benefit.
* A bias to action: you break big problems into pieces you can ship within a week, and you are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.
* Proficiency with version control systems, preferably Git.
* *Ideal but not required:* Experience building an LLM agent harness or real-time voice AI.
* The ability to work from our London (Spitalfields) office on Tuesdays and Thursdays, with the flexibility to work remotely or from the office on other days of the week.

* Competitive salary and equity share options.

* **Mental Health Support:** Access to dedicated mental health support services.

# Operations Strategy Manager - CX

Full-time

## Why We Exist

Our mission is to transform how technology is bought, used and reused - creating better outcomes for customers, brands and the planet.

## What We've Built

Raylo is the subscription infrastructure that enables leading electronics brands, including PlayStation, HP and Dyson, to move from one-off device sales to recurring subscription programmes that increase conversion, deepen loyalty and capture more lifetime value.

For customers, the experience is simple: subscribe to a device, get support throughout, upgrade when you want, and return it when you’re done. Behind that sits an AI-powered operating system that executes and manages device subscriptions end to end: credit and fraud decisioning, lifecycle operations, and the financing engine that enables brands to run subscription programmes at scale.

Brands can unlock a powerful new growth engine with Raylo across embedded checkout, Raylo.com and the customer app — converting more DTC customers, reaching subscription-first demand, and driving repeat upgrades that compound customer lifetime value.

The impact of our circular model is big. We cut emissions per device by around 50% compared to buy-and-discard. We’re B Corp certified, backed by Macquarie, NatWest and Channel 4 Ventures, and recognised by Tech Nation’s Future Fifty.

## How We Work

AI is changing what small, ambitious teams can build. Companies that embrace it will define the next decade.

Raylo is uniquely placed to benefit. We combine proprietary technology and data with the orchestration of physical assets, operating across credit, fraud, pricing, logistics, refurbishment, resale and customer care. With AI improving every cycle, our moat deepens with scale.

At Raylo, AI is woven into how we work every day. We don’t ration access or hedge our bets. Our people use the best models and tools, and we expect them to do things that weren’t possible a year ago. Processes that used to be good enough are being rebuilt. Teams are replacing spreadsheets with bespoke tooling, and anyone can query our data layer in plain English and get a real answer in seconds.

We give every team their own hackathon: a chance to step back, start with a blank sheet, and ask: if we were starting today, how would we do this?

The more we automate, the more human judgement matters. AI gives people back time, and we expect them to spend it on the things no model can replicate: conversations, trust, craft and team judgement.

We hire to a high bar. You’ll work with people who push you, raise your game and expect you to do the same. We want every person at Raylo to do the best work of their lives, and enjoy doing it.

## 💡 Be deeply curious

– We thrive on innovation through diverse approaches, views, and people.

## 👟 Walk in your customer’s shoes

– To build the best products and make the best decisions for the long term, we must figure out what our customers need, not just what they want.

## 🎯 Focus and execute

– We have a big vision, but we believe in nailing the most important problems first.

## 💥 Be gritty

– Only gritty teams succeed. Our individual ownership, passion, and perseverance mean we’re a team through thick and thin.

## Your Team

* Operations Strategy supports Raylo's ability to scale, improve efficiency and become more effective. We sit within Operations and own the Customer Experience, Supply Chain, and Revenue and Billing pillars. Our remit is to own operational projects, launch new initiatives and optimise processes that drive positive outcomes for Raylo's growth ambitions.
* AI is at the centre of how we work. We do not ration access, we use the best models, and we expect everyone on the team to push the tools harder than we currently do.
* This role owns the Customer Experience pillar end to end, and works closely with the Billing, Insurance, and Product and Engineering teams. As Raylo moves from a UK business to a global one, this role is accountable for making sure customer experience holds to the same standard everywhere, not just in the market we know best.

## What You’ll Do

* **Own what Wow CX means at Raylo.** Define the standard for a great interaction, hold every team (human or AI) to it, and be the escalation point and voice of the customer in cross-functional decisions, including product and engineering prioritisation.
* **Run the NPS programme end to end.** Own the survey infrastructure, run weekly and monthly analysis of headline scores, journey trends and verbatim themes, and turn that insight into decisions rather than a scorecard.
* **Anticipate pain points early.** Monitor feedback across Trustpilot, Intercom and NPS verbatims, quantify the cost of what you find, and build the business case for fixing it.
* **Own operational mass comms governance.** Audit, edit and govern the CX and service comms Raylo sends at scale, across customer.io and Fin: delivery updates, lifecycle messages, NPS surveys and Fin-driven support comms.
* **Triage and project manage major CX projects and issues.** Take ownership of live projects and issues end to end: root cause, fix, communication and close-out, coordinating internal teams as needed.
* **Set the global CX standard.** As Raylo launches into new markets, starting with the US, define what consistent CX means across markets and across our full device range, and build the standards and playbooks that stop quality slipping as we scale.
* **Test CX systematically, not just react to it.** Design and run structured testing across key customer journeys, including AI-handled paths, so we catch gaps before customers do.
* **Look outside Raylo for the bar to beat.** Study best-in-class CX from other industries (retail, travel, banking, hospitality) and bring back what's genuinely applicable, not just what other subscription businesses are doing.

## You’ll Succeed With

* **3-7 years' experience** in a customer experience, operations or strategy role, ideally with time in a scaleup, consulting or FMCG environment where you had direct exposure to the customer insights and worked at pace.
* **Degree level education** , ideally in a STEM or analytical discipline.
* **A genuine, sustained curiosity about the customer.** You notice pain points before they're reported, and you can't walk past a broken journey without wanting to fix it.
* **Comfortable building the case for change.** You can take a messy problem, quantify it, and write a business case that gets funded and shipped, not just noticed.
* **Some hands-on experience with a marketing automation or comms platform.** You've built, audited or governed comms sent at scale on a marketing automation platform, Customer.io experience is a strong plus, since that's our stack, but not required.
* **Strong analytical skills.** Confident in Excel or Google Sheets and tools like Looker, with the ability to pull data, find the root cause and write it up clearly. SQL experience is a plus; if you're not there yet, you'll get there quickly.
* **Deep curiosity and fluency with frontier AI tools.** You use Claude or ChatGPT daily, and have a view on how AI changes customer experience and support over the next few years.
* **Project management experience.** You can run several cross-functional issues at once, keep momentum, and know when to escalate versus when to push through.
* **Strong communication skills.** You're comfortable flagging issues early, explaining things clearly, and adapting your style depending on who you're talking to, from frontline teams to leadership.
* **Comfort with ambiguity.** This is a build-as-you-go role in a business moving from UK to global. You'll often be deciding what standard to set, not just following one.

🚀 Fast-track your career – 40% of our employees progress every review cycle (bi-annually)

📱 Exclusive Raylo device subscription for employees

🏥 Private Medical Insurance

📈 Stock options for all employees

The Directorate is also responsible for regeneration (where the programme is not housing led), enterprise, growth, capital projects and design work.

## About the team

The Mayor’s Infrastructure Coordination Service (ICS) is an innovative, award-winning, multi-disciplinary team that drives better collaboration in the planning and delivery of London’s utility infrastructure. This advertised role will sit within the sub-team responsible for the development and implementation of the SSM: the SuDS through Streetworks Market (SSM).

This is an exciting opportunity to play a leading role in the flagship innovation initiative: the SuDS through Streetworks Market (SSM). The SSM holds the potential of dramatically increasing SuDS by leveraging planned streetworks. This cross-organisational partnership – delivered in partnership with Thames Water – will put forward a market-led approach based on Nobel prize winning economics that will significantly reduce surface flooding risks and positively move the dial on green infrastructure across the city.

Our novel approach sits at the heart of London’s climate resilience agenda, supporting Flood Ready London as one of the London Surface Water Strategy’s key delivery mechanisms. Through the SSM, we are aiming to oversee two initial market rounds, deliver at least 100 projects and ultimately convert 7,000 hectares of impermeable land to SuDS to meet our target of number of properties at risk from a 1‐in‐30‐year storm.

---

## About the role

You will be part of a new 7-person team to implement the SuDS through Streetworks Market. This role is located in the Infrastructure team.

As Senior Data Analyst you will support the work of the SuDS through Streetworks Market (SSM) and wider Infrastructure team by managing the data and digital platforms required to deliver this high-profile programme.

The SSM will conduct market rounds through which ‘buyers’ – lead local flood authorities, Boroughs and Transport for London – together with ‘suppliers’ – utilities and contractors – trade credits to deliver SuDS projects.

Market rounds will be facilitated by a digital SSM Data and Trading Platform, which are the first points of contact for Buyers/Suppliers with the market. Buyers will use the platforms to submit bids (spatially selecting areas and the price they are willing to pay for a credit) and suppliers will submit areas where they are willing to deliver schemes and the price at which they are willing to do so.

You will be responsible for developing and managing these key tools, ensuring they remain regularly updated with high-quality data. This will include processing and analysing both spatial and non-spatial data using data science approaches. This role will also oversee the development of a pan-London SuDS Asset Register, which you will manage. Where relevant, you will be responsible for producing innovative, customised and interactive web mapping applications, tools and platforms to display the data and help programme delivery, whilst also generating relevant data analysis and undertaking essential monitoring & evaluation functions.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work on a high-profile programme with significant visibility across City Hall, government and industry. Whether your background is in management of digital and data projects, GIS, infrastructure or a related field, you will be motivated by using data to solve challenging problems, building effective partnerships and delivering tangible outcomes for Londoners.

#### Want to engage with the team?

If you would like to find out more about the roles and teams, please do join one of the upcoming webinars that will be listed on the following microsite dedicated to this recruitment campaign: GLA's Infrastructure Coordination Service: New Roles

## What your day will look like

* Leading data and digital procurements – to update the SSM Data Platform and develop a SuDS Asset Register.
* Managing data and digital consultants once appointed, at times ensuring consultants are speaking to each other.
* Ensuring all data/digital platforms (the SSM data platform and the pan-London SuDS asset register) are developed correctly and meet user requirements.
* Responding to data queries from LLFAs, utilities, and contractors to ensure Market Rounds run smoothly and they can use the digital platforms
* Undertaking data collection, where possible establishing APIs
* Ownership of data sharing processes (including NDA if required) and asset registers.
* Undertaking Monitoring & Evaluation (M&E) for reporting.
* Creating mapping visualisations of data and ad hoc data analysis aimed at SSM market participation and wider infrastructure delivery

* Experience managing and developing digital platforms, including engaging with suppliers and end users.
* Detailed knowledge of GIS in practical use, ideally in the field of SuDS or infrastructure delivery, and evidence of commitment to keep abreast of new developments.

About lowRISC CIC

lowRISC is a not-for-profit engineering organisation dedicated to making open-source silicon a commercial reality. Through collaborative, community-driven projects like OpenTitan (the world's first open-source silicon root of trust) and Ibex (a production-grade RISC-V CPU core), we develop and maintain high-quality, verified open IP that powers secure, next-generation hardware. Our small, expert team combines deep hardware knowledge with modern software and infrastructure practices to accelerate open silicon adoption across industry partners and the RISC-V ecosystem.

Role Overview

We're looking for a motivated Infrastructure Support Engineer. You'll support a compact but unusually broad infrastructure footprint that supports hardware design, security verification, FPGA-based testing, CI/CD for silicon projects, and collaborative open-source workflows.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a junior to mid-level engineer who thrives on learning new technologies quickly and enjoys making incremental improvements in a mission-focused setting. You'll gain hands-on experience across declarative infrastructure, zero-trust networking, hybrid cloud/on-prem Kubernetes, and custom tooling—while contributing directly to the productivity of engineers building foundational open-source silicon.

Key Responsibilities

* Help maintain and troubleshoot our on-prem Kubernetes cluster, powering hardware simulation, verification, and test workloads
* Support our Nebula overlay network as we build toward a robust zero-trust model across distributed engineering teams
* Operate and enhance self-hosted GitHub Actions runners, including an FPGA test rig that handles real hardware requests from CI workflows
* Maintain and gradually improve our Python-based internal tooling (used daily by hardware and software engineers) — refactoring for maintainability, adding features, and applying better software practices where it adds value
* Manage NixOS servers through declarative configurations for reproducible, reliable deployments
* Provision and manage Google Cloud resources (VMs, GKE-based runners, storage, networking) using Terraform / OpenTofu
* Monitor system health and respond to alerts
* Collaborate with hardware engineers, security specialists, and open-source contributors to debug issues spanning CI pipelines, FPGA rigs, cloud environments, and internal scripts
* Document setups, workflows, and lessons learned to help onboard new team members and partners

Required Skills & Experience

* Strong Linux fundamentals and comfort administering production-like systems
* Practical Python experience for scripting, automation, and maintaining existing codebases (you'll read and improve real-world Python tools regularly)
* Hands-on work with Kubernetes (basic operations, troubleshooting, YAML manifests)
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools like Terraform / OpenTofu (or similar)
* Solid Git/GitHub knowledge, ideally with Actions or CI/CD pipelines
* Curiosity and ability to ramp up on new tools and concepts quickly
* Clear communication skills for working across hardware, software, and infrastructure domains
* Experience using AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, or similar AI tools)

Desirable

* Any exposure to Nix or NixOS (personal projects welcome)
* Interest in or experience with Rust for performance-sensitive tooling
* Familiarity with Google Cloud (GCE, GKE, IAM)
* Knowledge of overlay/VPN technologies (Nebula, Tailscale, WireGuard) or zero-trust principles
* Previous involvement in CI for hardware/FPGA testing or open-source projects
* Experience with FPGA development

What We're Looking For

We're seeking someone who is excited by variety — you'll touch many different systems and technologies in a small team, gaining broad, valuable skills fast. The environment rewards initiative, problem-solving, and steady progress on both quick fixes and longer-term clean-ups. If you enjoy stretching yourself across open-source silicon tooling, hybrid infrastructure, and collaborative engineering — and you appreciate the satisfaction of making life easier for a team pushing the boundaries of secure hardware — this role offers real scope to grow while contributing to high-impact projects.

What We Offer

* Direct involvement in enabling open-source silicon at scale (OpenTitan, Ibex, and beyond)
* Exposure to an unusually diverse modern stack in a focused, mission-driven not-for-profit
* Opportunities to learn from hardware security experts, RISC-V specialists, and open-source collaborators
* Collaborative, low-ego culture with strong emphasis on quality and long-term maintainability

Salary dependent upon experience

lowRISC offers a generous benefits package including:

* 25 days annual leave plus 8 bank holidays.
* 12.5% employer’s pension contribution (subject to employee salary sacrifice of 6%).
* 4 weeks paid sabbatical after 4 years service.
* Private Medical Insurance, Group Income Protection Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Life Insurance.
* The opportunity to attend appropriate Industry conferences and/or training.
* Central Cambridge Office (near train station)

We are open to discussions about hybrid working after an initial probationary period.

# Blend Test Services Chemist Student Placement

**Location:** Hazelwood, Derbyshire, Great Britain  
**Job Type:** Full-Time, On-Site Student Placement (Year in Industry)

## How You'll Make an Impact

As a **Blend Test Services Chemist Student Placement**, you'll be at the forefront of our innovation, supporting the development and validation of lubricant technologies through physical and analytical testing. Working alongside experienced laboratory technicians, chemists, and PhD scientists, you will contribute to projects that influence industry standards, support product claims, and drive product quality improvements. In this role, you will:

* Perform accurate and reliable physical and analytical testing on lubricants and related products while adhering to laboratory protocols and safety standards.
* Compile, analyse, and communicate test results through clear written reports and presentations for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Collaborate with business leaders, scientists, and research and development teams to support new testing methodologies and research initiatives.
* Contribute to the improvement of industry standards by helping develop innovative testing procedures and evaluating vehicle fluid performance.
* Support knowledge sharing across laboratories by expanding your expertise and assisting with training and best practice activities throughout the department.

## Required Qualifications that Enable Your Success

* Currently pursuing a Chemistry or closely related scientific degree and seeking a Year in Industry placement as part of your academic programme.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present technical information clearly and effectively.
* Demonstrated ability to work accurately and methodically in a laboratory environment while following safety and quality standards.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Genuine interest in scientific research, innovation, and product development.

## Preferred Qualifications that Drive You Forward

* Previous laboratory experience gained through university studies, internships, placements, or research projects.
* Familiarity with analytical or physical chemistry techniques.
* Experience interpreting scientific data and preparing technical reports.
* Confidence presenting scientific findings to a variety of audiences.
* Interest in automotive, industrial, or specialty chemical applications.

## Your Work Environment

At Lubrizol, we're committed to providing a safe, inclusive, and empowering environment where you can do your best work. In this laboratory-based placement role, your work environment may include:

* Working within a laboratory setting using appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE).
* Operating specialised testing and analytical equipment.
* Standing and moving between laboratory workstations for extended periods.
* Following rigorous safety, environmental, and quality procedures.
* Collaborating closely with scientists, technicians, and cross-functional teams.
* Using digital tools to analyse results, prepare reports, and present findings.

We continuously invest in our facilities and technologies to support your wellbeing, productivity, and growth. If you require reasonable accommodation, we are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible experience.

## Benefits that Empower You

* Competitive salary.
* Discretionary performance bonus scheme.
* 33 days annual leave including bank holidays.
* Comprehensive pension scheme.
* Flexible working hours.
* Opportunity to support and integrate final-year project work within practical industry research.
* Access to subsidised sports and social clubs (location dependent).
* Subsidised on-site restaurant facilities.
* Free on-site parking.
* Learning and development opportunities.
* Career and professional growth within a global organisation.

## Our Commitment

Lubrizol is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We are committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive.

## Next Steps

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis until a sufficient number of candidates have been identified. We encourage you to apply as early as possible.

To be considered, applicants must:

* Be eligible to work in the United Kingdom throughout the duration of the placement.
* Have completed at least two years of an undergraduate degree programme.
* Not have graduated before the start of the placement.

Our specialty chemistry solutions—from engine oils, performance coatings, and skincare to medical devices and plumbing systems —are powered by the expertise, passion, and commitment of people like you. **About Marex Solutions**

Marex Solutions is a division of Marex providing investment banking solutions with a fintech mindset. We aim to become the world's leading manufacturer of cross-asset, customised derivatives, combining deep structured products expertise with proprietary technology to deliver tailored hedging and investment solutions to clients around the world.

The business is entrepreneurial and fast-growing. We champion innovation, challenge existing processes, and think outside the box to find a solution for any problem we encounter. We work collaboratively across functions, contribute to a positive team culture that enables people to thrive, and give ambitious individuals genuine ownership and the opportunity to grow with the business.

**Overview of the Department**

Marex Solutions specialises in the manufacture and distribution of customised derivative and structured products through its two business lines, Hedging Solutions and Financial Products, combining fintech-driven innovation with deep markets expertise to serve clients around the world. The Business Development team partners closely with the regional Sales heads and teams, the Markets and Product teams, as well as Corporate Affairs, Legal and Compliance to grow the segment's client base and market share.

**Role Summary**

Reporting to the Head of Business Development, this role will be a core member of the Business Development team within Marex's Hedging and Investment Solutions segment. The Business Development team's priority is to contribute to the commercial objectives of the business - increasing revenues from reaching new clients and gaining market share in the OTC derivatives and structured products markets for corporates and professional investors respectively.

The VP will use market intelligence and draw up the competitive landscape to help define the opportunity and positioning for the business in the European market, to shape the go-to-market strategy, working closely with the sales teams. You will plan and drive with the team 360° marketing campaigns — from content creation to digital distribution, and in-person events.

The successful candidate will be encouraged to identify opportunities to add value across the business. Marex is a growing firm, and this individual will grow with it. Where business development intersects with marketing, communications or client engagement, this person can and should be involved.

This role exists to ensure Marex presents a clear, credible and compelling offering to its clients and markets — and to find new and scalable ways to do that across an expanding platform, spending carefully and intentionally to make every dollar count.

**Business Development**

* Define the market opportunity and positioning for the business in the European market by using market intelligence and drawing up the competitive landscape, working closely with the sales teams

* Identify opportunities and gaps, exploring partnerships and developing new initiatives where marketing can add commercial or reputational value — and bringing those ideas forward with a clear rationale
* Spend carefully and intentionally, making every dollar count and prioritising investment in the activities that deliver the greatest impact

* Stay up to date on industry developments, market news, product developments, market data and our target audiences — understanding the dynamics that influence behaviour and using those insights to shape business development strategy and initiatives

* Strong understanding of structured products and financial markets, with the ability to translate technical concepts into compelling marketing content
* Knowledge and understanding of our target audience — professional and institutional investors, corporates and treasurers, and consumers and producers of commodities
* Experience working in a regulated environment, staying up to date on legal and compliance requirements around financial communications and promotions
* Proven experience in business development & marketing, supported by study or professional training in the field, and fluent in marketing best practice — applying and adapting it to commercial objectives
* Demonstrated track record delivering 360° campaigns from conception to production, and distribution

# FP&A Analyst (Revenue & COGS) – Entry Level role

## Job Description

Posted Sunday, October 18, 2026 at 10:00 PM

**Who we are**

At MediaKind, we’ve reshaped the future of streaming video.

As the world’s largest independent video technology company, and the leader in sports streaming, we power the most ambitious and demanding video experiences on the planet.

Our cloud-native, software-defined solutions help the world’s leading streamers and broadcasters build, deploy and scale premium video experiences. Its MK.IO platform helps customers launch and scale streaming services. Finance supports a business that mixes software subscriptions, usage-based cloud services, licenses, and professional and managed services, so revenue and delivery cost do not follow one simple pattern.

If you're excited by solving complex challenges, working alongside talented colleagues around the world, and helping shape the future of video, we'd love to build what's next together.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for an FP&A Analyst to own revenue and cost of goods sold (COGS) forecasting, reporting and analysis. You will be the person the business turns to for an accurate answer on what we will bill, what it will cost to deliver, and what margin that leaves. The role sits in Finance and works daily with Sales, Operations and Customer Delivery.

This is a hands-on analyst role. You will help build and maintain the models, reconcile them to the general ledger, and explain the movements to non-finance leaders in plain language.

**Key responsibilities**

**Revenue**

* Build and maintain the monthly, quarterly and annual revenue forecast by division, customer and revenue type (subscription, usage, license, services, support).
* Combine closed actuals, invoiced and to-be-invoiced orders, and the sales pipeline into one view of revenue by period.
* Track backlog and open orders, flag slippage, and quantify the revenue impact of deal timing changes.
* Analyze revenue versus budget, forecast and prior year, and write the variance commentary: volume, price, mix and timing.
* Support revenue recognition review with Accounting, including checks on contract terms and billing schedules.

**COGS and gross margin**

* Forecast and report COGS split between direct costs (hosting, third-party licenses, royalties, delivery and support labour) and indirect costs allocated to delivery.
* Calculate gross margin by division, customer and project, and highlight where margin is falling and why.
* Maintain the mapping of general ledger accounts to revenue and COGS categories so reporting stays consistent.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering on cloud and vendor cost drivers, and model the margin effect of pricing, contract and architecture changes.
* Build customer and deal-level margin analysis to support pricing and renewal decisions.

**Reporting and close**

* Run the monthly gross margin close: refresh the GL data, reconcile to the ledger, and confirm summaries tie out.
* Produce the revenue and COGS pages of the monthly management pack and board reporting.
* Support budget and reforecast cycles with accurate, well-documented assumptions.

**Partnering and improvement**

* Meet regularly with Sales, Customer Delivery and Operations to challenge assumptions and explain results.
* Answer ad hoc questions from the CFO and leadership team with clear, fast analysis.
* Document models and processes and automate repeat reporting so the team spends time on analysis, not on rebuilding spreadsheets.

## **Requirements**

* 3 or more years in FP&A, financial analysis or a similar finance role.
* Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field. Relevant experience will also be considered.
* Direct experience forecasting revenue and analyzing gross margin or COGS.
* Advanced Excel: lookups, pivot tables, multi-tab models, and the discipline to make every total tie out. Comfortable with large general ledger exports.
* Working knowledge of an ERP such as Oracle, and of a CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
* Clear written and spoken communication. You can explain a variance to a sales director without jargon.
* Strong attention to detail and a habit of checking your own work before anyone else sees it.

## **Nice to have**

* SQL, Power BI, Tableau or similar for reporting and dashboards.
* Experience with planning tools such as Adaptive, Anaplan or Planful.
* Python or other scripting to automate recurring reporting.
* Experience with cloud cost reporting (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud) and usage-based billing.
* Exposure to multi-currency reporting and intercompany allocations.
* Experience with Ai Tools

## **What success looks like**

| Timeframe | Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| First 30 days | Learn the GL, the revenue and COGS mappings, and the month-end close. Shadow one full close and tie out the gross margin summary. |
| First 60 days | Run the revenue and COGS reporting for a month with light review. Take over the variance commentary for at least one division. |
| First 90 days | Own the revenue and COGS forecast end to end. Deliver one analysis that changes a pricing, contract or cost decision. Propose and start one automation of a manual report. |

Southampton, Hybrid

The Meta Reality Labs Research Team brings together a world-class team of researchers, developers, and engineers to create the future of virtual and augmented reality, which together will become as universal and essential as smartphones and personal computers are today. And just as personal computers have done over the past 45 years, AR, VR and MR will ultimately change everything about how we work, play, and connect. We are developing all the technologies needed to enable breakthrough AR glasses and VR headsets, including optics and displays, computer vision, audio, graphics, brain-computer interfaces, haptic interaction, eye/hand/face/body tracking, perception science, and true telepresence. Some of those will advance much faster than others, but they all need to happen to enable AR, VR and MR that are so compelling that they become an integral part of our lives.

See more about our work here: Inside Facebook Reality Labs Research: The future of audio and Filter Out the Noise With Conversation Focus. These two initiatives will allow us to connect people by allowing them to feel together despite being physically apart, and allow them to converse in even the most difficult listening environments.
Meta Reality Labs Research is looking for an intern who is passionate about speech perception and audio quality to investigate why processed speech sometimes sounds degraded or robotic. The project focuses on identifying systematic phonemic errors as causal factors in perceived quality degradation, and linking these errors to human quality and intelligibility judgments. A core method is to explore the capabilities of audio vs video LLMs. This is fundamentally a speech-perception research role; multimodal/LLM methods are a supporting tool rather than the central focus.

* Review, interpret, and approve the implementation of **engineering drawings, specifications, method statements, ITPs, technical documentation, and construction deliverables**.

* Take ownership of site engineering issues, coordinating **technical queries, RFIs, design clarifications, non-conformances, and corrective actions** through to resolution.

* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities across multiple workstreams and project sites.

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

As a Senior Sales Manager at Mews, you will own a territory—and own it at scale. We are approaching IPO. The market is global, the product is unmatched, and the territories are genuinely winnable at scale. The question is whether you are the person to own a territory and lift the entire team's standard.

## What you would do

* Full ownership of a territory with quota targets, closing deals (€5,000+)
* Strategic territory growth planning: building 2-3 year plans, not just quarterly targets

* A pipeline built from outbound prospecting, with strategic account planning and targeted expansion
* Mentoring and coaching of Sales Managers—not just your own discipline, but their development
* Thought partnership with commercial leadership on scaling motions, team development, and market strategy

* Use AI to redesign how your territory and team work, not just how you personally work. Build an AI-powered territory analysis framework your team follows. Create deal-coaching workflows that scale your mentoring. Actively question what AI gives you and know when to abandon an output.

You've built approaches other Sales Managers follow—whether it's an AI-powered territory analysis framework, a prospecting workflow that uses AI to prioritize accounts, or a deal-coaching process that scales your mentoring. You actively question what AI gives you, push back when it's wrong, and know when to abandon an output entirely. At IC3, you're thinking about how to multiply yourself through AI and through your team, not just how it speeds up your own work.
