* Experience in a communications, digital, media, or marketing agency, with a strong focus on paid social and digital marketing.

* Experience working with B2B clients; experience across B2C or consumer-facing campaigns is also valuable.

* Demonstrable experience planning and activating paid social campaigns across platforms such as Google, LinkedIn, YouTube, and Meta.

* Experience managing significant campaign budgets and optimizing performance against agreed objectives.

* Strong understanding of growth marketing, full-funnel activity, and the different roles of brand awareness and lead generation.

* Confidence using data and analytics to measure results, report on ROI, and make practical recommendations.

* An understanding of wider digital trends, advertising products, and emerging formats.

* Strong client-facing, presentation, written, and verbal communication skills.

* Commercial awareness, including experience managing budgets, account growth, and new-business opportunities.

Europe's largest enterprises are moving more communications and customer workflows into software and AI, but they face real constraints around data residency, telecom requirements, legacy systems, procurement and cross-border operations. The opportunity is to make that technical differentiation relevant to the buying priorities of European multinationals, prove it in initial deployments and expand into durable enterprise relationships.

#### What you'll build

* A European enterprise organization. Build an initial team of eight enterprise account executives, paired one-to-one with field development engineers (FDEs). Establish the pod model, hiring bar, management cadence and shared technical-sales accountability. Scale toward 16 sellers only when repeatable performance supports it.

Expansion should follow initial production success, not just an impressive proof of concept.

Early success means building an exceptional initial team, identifying a defensible set of priority markets and named accounts, personally helping progress lighthouse deals and establishing replicable wins. Longer term, we want a European enterprise organization that can forecast reliably and grow without requiring bespoke execution on every account.

* You've built and led enterprise sales teams across multiple European markets and personally helped close substantial, complex B2B technology deals with large regional or multinational customers.

#### Why Telnyx

You will build a direct enterprise business across one of the world's most demanding markets, with meaningful ownership of regional strategy, team design and major customer relationships. ## About Us

At Teton, we are redefining the role of healthcare workers through cutting-edge AI technology. Facing a global nursing shortage, our solutions offer vital support to overburdened health systems. With thousands of patient rooms across 4 countries already benefiting from our technology, we are aiming to expand to much more. We distinguish ourselves by focusing relentlessly on product excellence and user experience, rapidly deploying solutions that make a real difference.

## The Job

Every patient room we deploy into puts another device on infrastructure we don't control, in a building we can't easily visit, running software that has to keep working. We're looking for an Engineer to own that problem: the systems, tooling, and infrastructure that let us ship to thousands of edge devices confidently and understand what they're doing once they're out there.

In this role, you will focus on the following areas of interest:

* **Fleet Management:** Build and run the systems that provision, monitor, and manage our devices in the field, from first boot in a hospital room to end of life.
* **OTA & Release Engineering:** Own how software gets onto devices: staged rollouts, health checks, automatic rollback, and the confidence that a bad release won't take down a ward.
* **Observability:** Design the telemetry, logging, and alerting that tell us a device is degrading before a nurse notices. Make remote debugging possible so we don't fly to fix things.
* **Device Bring-Up & Debugging:** Work with our hardware and firmware teams on new hardware revisions, reproduce field issues on the bench, and get to the bottom of problems that span kernel, driver, network, and application.
* **Infrastructure & Tooling:** Build the CI/CD, image builds, and internal tools that let the whole engineering team ship to hardware quickly and safely.
* **Documentation:** Maintain clear and detailed documentation of your work to ensure easy collaboration and knowledge sharing within the team.

## Qualifications:

* Solid experience running Linux systems in production: ideally embedded or edge Linux, not just cloud VMs.
* Proficiency in Rust and/or Javascript/Typescript and/or Python
* Experience with device fleets at scale: provisioning, OTA update mechanisms (Mender, RAUC, balena, or something you built yourself), and remote access to constrained devices.
* Familiarity with Linux internals: systemd, kernel modules, device tree, networking stack, containers.
* Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar) and designing what to measure, not just wiring up dashboards.
* Comfortable with hardware debugging: serial consoles, working alongside hardware engineers

**ABOUT AIREDALE**

 Airedale Group are the leading market design, installation, and maintenance provider for commercial kitchens in the UK hospitality and food service industry. We work alongside clients from the initial designs through to bespoke fabrication and installation. Coupled with the largest body of professional maintenance engineers in the country, we offer the complete end-to-end solution to our extensive client base. We have long-standing relationships with many of the biggest multi-site brands in the UK.

**ABOUT LIGHTHOUSE**

Lighthouse is Airedale Group's IoT platform for commercial kitchens. We monitor and control the equipment inside them — fryers, grills, ovens, refrigeration, boilers — across the estates of some of the UK's best-known restaurant and pub brands. Unusually, we do not only observe that equipment; we control it, which is why major customers trust us with live cooking assets.

Energy savings opened the door, but they are not the product. The same data already evidences food safety compliance, stock loss prevention, cleaning compliance, remote fault diagnosis and — most significantly — early warning of equipment failure. Our predictive proof of concept identified drift several days before failures were logged, validated against real engineer job history rather than synthetic data.

Our board has funded a dedicated data and analytics capability to turn that evidence into product. This role builds it.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

As Senior IoT Data & AI Engineer, you will convert proven analysis into running systems. Working alongside our IoT data analyst, who holds the domain knowledge and customer relationships, you will build the data platform, the predictive models and the automated reporting that allow insight to be produced repeatedly rather than by hand.

The first priority is early failure detection. We have committed to delivering it for a major customer, and getting it into service — then proving how accurate it is — is your first quarter.

This is a hands-on role in a deliberately small team. You will work directly with the CTO and with our IoT data analyst, who is your closest working partner: they define what good looks like and validate that what you build is right; you make it repeatable. You will also collaborate with the wider Airedale group data team on shared standards as that function develops.

You will not be required to run the monthly customer reporting meetings — the analyst leads those — but you should expect to join customers periodically and for technical discussions. Engineers who never meet the customer build the wrong thing.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Take our anomaly detection work from proof of concept into production across the estate, moving from retrospective analysis to live early warning.
* Build the validation loop that joins every alert to the engineer's finding, so detection accuracy is measured rather than asserted.
* Develop the failure-signature library from telemetry crossed with twenty years of service history — the asset that makes our predictions defensible and that no competitor can replicate.
* Tune alerting continuously so it stays actionable and does not become noise.
* Own the flow from ThingsBoard, currently on managed hosting, into Microsoft Fabric — streaming ingest, full-history archive, and the conformed layer beneath everything else.
* Build the derived data layer: asset state classification, expected consumption and baselines, deviation scoring, an event register and governed metric definitions.
* Evaluate ThingsBoard Trends Analytics against building our own and make the recommendation on evidence — then implement it.
* Apply proper engineering discipline: version control, testing, reproducibility. Nothing should depend on a script on someone's laptop.
* Build with large language models as a core part of the role, not an experiment: generated report narratives, plain-language explanation of anomalies, and a conversational interface over our data.
* Deliver that interface against the governed data layer, with customer isolation enforced properly and an evaluation suite that proves answers are correct.
* Maintain the boundary that matters: figures are computed in the data layer and narrated by the model, never generated by it.
* Industrialise the customer reporting our analyst currently produces by hand, so that it scales as the estate grows rather than consuming more people.
* Publish analytics outputs to our customer portal through served APIs.

**EXPERIENCE REQUIRED**

* Strong Python and SQL, with production experience building and operating data pipelines — ideally in Microsoft Fabric, or a comparable lakehouse platform such as Databricks, Synapse or a dbt-based stack.
* Hands-on experience with time-series, sensor or telemetry data at scale, including the realities of gaps, drift, flatlines and misbehaving devices.
* Applied anomaly detection or predictive modelling taken into production, with the judgement to keep methods robust and explainable rather than elaborate.
* Practical experience building with LLM APIs beyond chat use: retrieval, tool use, generated reporting, and evaluation of model outputs.
* Self-directed and adaptable, comfortable owning delivery end to end in a small team without an engineering department to fall back on.
* Able to explain technical work clearly to non-technical colleagues and customers.

The Airedale Group is expanding rapidly, employing circa 700 people across multiple locations in the UK. This is a fantastic time to be joining the business with opportunities for career progression.

* **Use good judgement in how you work**, balancing speed with quality, adapting to changing priorities and raising risks early.
* **Use AI confidently and critically** throughout your work, from writing SQL and dbt models to exploring data, while checking outputs and applying your own judgement.

* You've used data to **understand how people use a product**, and you think about what the findings mean for the product, not just the numbers.
* You can explain complex findings clearly to people without a technical background and confidently recommend what to do next.
* You've done **hands-on data analytics work**, turning raw data into useful insights that inform decisions.
* You **use AI tools in your daily work** and know when to question, check or challenge what they give you.
* You're **comfortable taking ownership of your work**, making decisions within your area and moving things forward independently, while knowing when to bring others in.

If you don't tick every box but this sounds like you, we'd still like to hear from you.

* Experience across the full data pipeline, including tracking, ingestion, pipelines, modelling and visualisation.

At Trailmix, we care as much about how you work as what you deliver. We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted and able to take ownership. That care carries through to how we work together and ultimately into the games we make for our players.

Our office is a place where ideas come together, and we work side by side to turn them into reality.

Our hybrid work model combines the flexibility of remote work with the creative energy of being together in person.

We work from our Kings Cross studio together **three days a week - Monday, Thursday, and Friday**, because we believe great games (and great teams) are built through genuine collaboration.

These days are focused, energised, and designed for impact:

* We **solve problems faster**

This rhythm helps us deliver our best work not just for each other, but for our players. It's how we build momentum, grow together, and stay ahead in a fast-moving industry.

Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

That’s why we’re building a Talent team that sees recruiting as a craft and a competitive advantage, people who challenge assumptions, move with urgency, and are energized by building exceptional teams to solve incredibly hard problems. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you."

– Alicia Strait, VP of Talent, TRM Labs

As TRM expands across EMEA and other global markets, our ability to hire the right sellers, compliance experts, and go-to-market talent in-region determines how fast our blockchain intelligence reaches the institutions and agencies fighting illicit finance worldwide. As an **International Sales Recruiter**, you'll own high-priority searches across EMEA and beyond — Sales, Post-Sales, Compliance, Marketing, and broader business roles — partnering closely with hiring managers and Talent leadership to define strategy, map regional markets, engage passive candidates, and drive high-quality hiring decisions with speed and precision.

Your success is measured by the quality, velocity, and business impact of the hires you make across TRM's international business functions.

**The impact you'll have:**

* Own full-cycle recruiting for international roles across Sales, Post-Sales, Compliance, Marketing, and other functions.
* Act as a strategic talent partner to hiring managers, including advising on market dynamics, candidate calibration, sourcing strategy, and close approach.
* Build and execute targeted sourcing strategies that identify, engage, and close exceptional talent across EMEA and other global markets.
* Develop regional talent maps across priority markets that include high-performing companies, competitive talent, referral networks, and specialized candidate communities.
* Create an exceptional candidate experience where every touchpoint reflects TRM's talent bar, mission, and operating principles.
* Use data, market insight, and funnel conversion metrics to diagnose search health, influence hiring teams, and adjust strategy in real time.
* Drive urgency and decision quality through clear calibration, structured feedback, and timely hiring decisions.
* Continuously improve international recruiting including intake quality, scorecard alignment, sourcing strategy, debrief rigor, and offer execution.
* Partner cross-functionally with Talent, People, Finance, Legal, and business leaders to navigate international hiring considerations and keep searches moving.

* 7+ years of recruiting experience, with strong experience supporting international sales hiring in high-growth technology companies.
* Proven success hiring across Sales, Post-Sales, Compliance, Marketing, and other business functions.
* Strong knowledge of EMEA talent markets, with the ability to adapt strategy by region, function, and candidate profile.
* Strong search fundamentals including market mapping, talent intelligence, passive candidate engagement, candidate assessment, and closing.
* The ability to quickly understand complex business roles across GTM, compliance, marketing, and operations.
* Strong analytical ability to interpret recruiting metrics, funnel health, conversion rates, and pipeline quality and translate them into action.
* Exceptional stakeholder management that includes building trust, influencing hiring managers, pushing back thoughtfully, and operating as a strategic advisor.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including synthesizing market insight, candidate tradeoffs, and search progress clearly for stakeholders.
* High ownership, autonomy, persistence, and judgment in navigating ambiguous, specialized, business-critical searches.
* The ability to operate effectively in a remote, globally distributed environment with strong overlap across EMEA and U.S. business hours.

* We stay tightly aligned through weekly hiring syncs, team sourcing syncs, and bi-weekly team meetings where we solve challenges together.
* We care deeply about our craft: we continuously refine best practices and data quality to deliver an exceptional experience for candidates and internal stakeholders alike, backed by precise, reliable reporting.
* We're globally distributed but most of us overlap between 7am–12pm PST for real-time collaboration.
* Every team member, wherever they're based, maintains at least a 4-hour overlap with PST business hours.

* The estimated base salary range for this role is $153,000 - $172,000.
* Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.
* **Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.**

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

* **Recruiter Intro:** Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.
* **Hiring Manager:** Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.
* **First Round:** 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.
* **Final Round:** Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

* **Offer:** Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.
* **Welcome to TRM:** We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

* Accelerate repeatable workflows
* Structure and solve problems
* Improve output quality
* Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

* Priorities and targets to change quickly
* Operating with a high degree of ambiguity
* A high level of personal ownership and accountability
* Close collaboration across teams and functions
* Frequent, high-touch communication
* Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking
* A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

* Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.
* Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‐to‐end, and invest in getting better everyday.
* Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‐team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

## **Join our Mission**

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

# Full Stack Agentic Developer

## About Eidra UK

Eidra is a collective of around 1,600 people across design, technology, data and business transformation companies, including Umain, Kurppa Hosk, Above and Curamando. Eidra UK brings that capability together for UK clients from our London base.

Umain is the engineering practice inside Eidra UK. We design, build and run digital products at scale: apps with 400M+ downloads, platforms serving 50M+ monthly active users, and backends handling tens of thousands of requests per second.

We are building Eidra UK around an AI-first way of delivering software. This role sits at the centre of that.

## The role

We’re looking for a full stack developer who already works agentically. You write clear specs, run multiple agents in parallel against them, choose the right model for each job, and take full ownership of what ships.

You’ll work on client products end to end, from shaping requirements with stakeholders through to production. You’ll also help define how Eidra UK builds software with agents: the practices, tooling and standards the rest of the team uses.

## How we build

We start from a clear spec, break the work into tasks agents can complete, run those agents in parallel, verify the output with tests, evals and review, then ship. The spec is the source of truth. Agents do much of the implementation. You own the spec, the orchestration and the quality of the result.

## What you’ll do

**Spec driven delivery**

* Define requirements in a structured way: identify the actors, describe their use cases, then derive the features that serve them.
* Turn client needs into specs that both people and agents can build against: clear scope, acceptance criteria, interfaces and constraints.
* Keep specs, tests and code in step as the product changes.
* Break work into units that agents can complete and verify independently.

**Agent orchestration**

* Run and coordinate agent swarms: parallel agents, subagents and specialised roles (planning, implementation, review, testing).
* Build and maintain the supporting tooling: MCP servers, agent skills, prompts, context files and isolated workspaces.
* Design the checks that keep agent output trustworthy: test coverage, evals, guardrails and human review points.

**Model selection and mixing**

* Combine frontier and open-weight models to deliver results.
* Route work by capability, cost, latency and data sensitivity, including self-hosted or private deployments where client data requires it.
* Measure model performance on real tasks and change the mix when the evidence says so.

**Full stack engineering**

* Build secure, scalable web applications with TypeScript, React and Next.js.
* Build backend services and APIs with Node.js and NestJS.
* Create reusable UI components using design system principles.
* Work with cloud infrastructure (GCP, AWS or Azure), infrastructure as code with Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Build observable systems with metrics, logging and tracing, including for LLM and agent behaviour in production.

**Clients and team**

* Work directly with clients and cross-functional teams across design, product and data.
* Explain agentic delivery, its trade-offs and its limits to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Share what works: pair with colleagues, document patterns and help raise the agentic practice across Eidra UK.

## What we’re looking for

* 3+ years of professional full stack experience, with strong TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node.js and core web fundamentals.
* Hands-on experience delivering production software with coding agents (for example Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar), beyond autocomplete.
* Strong requirement definition experience, working from actors to use cases to feature definitions with clear acceptance criteria.
* A working spec driven development practice. You can show specs you’ve written and what agents built from them.
* Experience running multiple agents in parallel and coordinating their output.
* Practical experience using both frontier and open-weight models, with a view on when each is the right choice.
* Strong engineering judgement. You read and review agent output critically and you own the result as your own code.
* Comfort with ambiguity, and the consulting instinct to work it through with clients.
* Curiosity. The tools change monthly and you enjoy keeping up.

## Nice to have

* Building agentic features into client products: tool calling, RAG, MCP servers, multi-agent workflows.
* Running open-weight models in production (for example vLLM, Ollama or managed inference).
* LLM evaluation and observability tooling.
* Contributions to open source agent tooling or published writing on agentic engineering.
* Tailwind CSS, Storybook and design system work.
* Experience in a consultancy or agency setting.

## Working setup

London is the default office. You’ll work remotely when it suits the team or the client.

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason - the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

You'll primarily be responsible for our application security, working with our product teams to work on new systems to enhance our security posture. As we integrate AI-powered agents into our engineering and operations workflows, you'll help define and enforce the guardrails around how we use them safely. * Centralise application-level login and permissions enforcement including privileged access management

Our engineers, data scientists and analysts already build data products with tools like Claude Code, but the AI agents are only as good as the data they can reach. Our data stack (Snowflake, dbt, AWS, OpenMetadata) is already top-of-class and has been recognised by peers at conferences - your job is to take it to the next level.    
  
You will cut the time it takes to build and ship a data model from days to hours. You will own our data architecture end to end: modelling, pipelines, governance and the stack underneath. You will decide what gets rebuilt, evolved, or retired. You will make data discoverable, trusted and usable by humans and agents alike.

*Location: Bucharest (RO), London (UK), Oslo (NO)*

* Own the pipelines that feed the Xeneta platform with data, and decide what gets rebuilt, evolved or retired.
* Redesign our data models in Snowflake and dbt so a data scientist or engineer can go from an idea to shipped model in hours, not days - without messing up the critical data in production.
* Make our data usable by AI agents: clean semantics, documented lineage, and metadata that Claude Code and other AI tools can read and act on reliably.
* Educate the tech and data teams as well as the wider organisation on using data with AI tools.

* Strong opinion on what good user- and developer experience looks like in your area, and a desire to constantly improve the tools that you use.
* Experience using AI tools like Claude Code as the default way you write, review and maintain systems.
* Expertise with data pipeline tools, cloud services, and Snowflake ecosystem.
* Proven expertise in modeling data using advanced SQL.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

* You are a team player, and you enjoy learning and improving the team around you and yourself.
* You have a strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, curiosity, and daring when venturing into unknown territory.

You will take ownership of test vehicles, ensuring they are properly equipped and maintained to meet evolving business and testing needs, and collaborate with other engineers to build and maintain lab-based automated test setups. Drive Testing & Field Validation

Safely simulate real-world driving scenarios to trigger and verify system behaviour.
Record and document test results, environmental conditions and system responses.
Take ownership of test vehicles, including installation, configuration and maintenance of required hardware and accessories to support ongoing testing and business requirements.
Video Review & Classification

Collaborate with QA engineers to reproduce and isolate bugs or unexpected behaviour.

Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.

Xylem is seeking an experienced Project Engineer to lead the successful delivery of complex temporary pumping, bypass and dewatering projects across the UK water and utilities sector. In this role you will be working alongside leading Tier 1 contractors and major utility clients including Anglian Water, Severn Trent Water and other key framework customers, you will take ownership of projects from initial handover through mobilisation, installation, operation and final demobilisation.

  

This is an exciting opportunity for an established Project Engineer looking to take a leading role in delivering critical infrastructure projects that directly support the operation and maintenance of essential water and wastewater networks.

You will work at the interface between engineering, operations, commercial teams and customers, ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on programme and within budget.

  

Project Delivery

·       Manage and coordinate the delivery of pump rental, bypass pumping and temporary works projects from award through to completion.

·       Act as the primary project lead between customers, operations teams, engineering teams, suppliers and subcontractors.

·       Develop and maintain project programmes, resource plans and delivery schedules.

·       Coordinate all mobilisation activities including plant, equipment, labour, transport, lifting operations, electrical installations and site access requirements.

·       Monitor project performance, identify risks and implement mitigation measures to maintain programme and budget objectives.

·       Provide regular project updates to customers, internal stakeholders and senior management.

·       Manage project close-out activities, capturing lessons learned and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.

·       Resolve technical issues that arise during project execution.

·       Support forecasting, reporting and project financial performance reviews.

We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded Project Engineer who can confidently lead projects, build credibility with customers and deliver successful outcomes in challenging operational environments.

·       Work on critical infrastructure programmes that support essential public services.

·       Join an industry-leading provider of pumping and water technology solutions.

Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.

Xylem is seeking an experienced Project Engineer to lead the successful delivery of complex temporary pumping, bypass and dewatering projects across the UK water and utilities sector. In this role you will be working alongside leading Tier 1 contractors and major utility clients including Anglian Water, Severn Trent Water and other key framework customers, you will take ownership of projects from initial handover through mobilisation, installation, operation and final demobilisation.

  

This is an exciting opportunity for an established Project Engineer looking to take a leading role in delivering critical infrastructure projects that directly support the operation and maintenance of essential water and wastewater networks.

You will work at the interface between engineering, operations, commercial teams and customers, ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on programme and within budget.

  

Project Delivery

·       Manage and coordinate the delivery of pump rental, bypass pumping and temporary works projects from award through to completion.

·       Act as the primary project lead between customers, operations teams, engineering teams, suppliers and subcontractors.

·       Develop and maintain project programmes, resource plans and delivery schedules.

·       Coordinate all mobilisation activities including plant, equipment, labour, transport, lifting operations, electrical installations and site access requirements.

·       Monitor project performance, identify risks and implement mitigation measures to maintain programme and budget objectives.

·       Provide regular project updates to customers, internal stakeholders and senior management.

·       Manage project close-out activities, capturing lessons learned and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.

  

Customer & Stakeholder Management

·       Build strong relationships with Tier 1 contractors, water companies and key framework customers.

·       Attend client meetings, design reviews, planning sessions and site progress meetings.

·       Ensure customer requirements are fully understood and translated into successful project delivery plans.

·       Act as a trusted technical and operational contact throughout the project lifecycle.

·       Support business growth through the delivery of exceptional customer service and project performance.

  

Technical Leadership

·       Review project requirements and ensure proposed pumping solutions are practical, safe and commercially viable.

·       Provide technical oversight during the planning and delivery of temporary pumping installations.

·       Work closely with electrical, mechanical and temporary works specialists to develop robust project solutions.

·       Support technical reviews covering pump selection, generators, variable speed drives, control systems, pipelines, lifting operations and associated temporary works.

·       Resolve technical issues that arise during project execution.

  

Commercial & Contract Management

·       Monitor project costs, utilisation and expenditure against approved budgets.

·       Support forecasting, reporting and project financial performance reviews.

·       Manage variations, compensation events and project changes where applicable.

·       Ensure commercial risks and opportunities are identified and managed effectively.

·       Maintain a strong understanding of NEC contracts and project delivery obligations.

  

Health, Safety, Environment & Quality

·       Ensure projects are delivered in full compliance with company, client and legislative requirements.

·       Lead project planning activities, including RAMS reviews, project documentation and risk assessments.

·       Promote a positive safety culture across project teams and supply chain partners.

·       Ensure all project personnel and subcontractors operate to required competency and compliance standards.

·       Drive continual improvement in safety, quality and operational performance.

**Skills & Experience**

  

Essential

·       Proven experience as a Project Engineer delivering infrastructure, utility, construction, temporary works or pump rental projects.

·       Experience working directly with Tier 1 contractors and utility companies.

·       Strong understanding of project delivery, planning and coordination principles.

·       Experience managing multiple stakeholders across operational, engineering and commercial functions.

·       Excellent communication and customer-facing skills.

·       Demonstrable experience managing project risks, resources and programme requirements.

·       Knowledge of RAMS, site safety requirements and CDM principles.

·       Strong commercial awareness and understanding of project profitability.

Desirable

·       Experience delivering temporary pumping, bypass pumping or dewatering projects.

·       Experience within the UK water sector.

·       Knowledge of NEC3 and NEC4 contracts.

·       Electrical or mechanical engineering background.

·       SMSTS, IOSH Managing Safely or equivalent qualification.

·       APM, PRINCE2 or similar project management qualification.

·       Experience managing subcontractors and specialist suppliers.

What We're Looking For

  

We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded Project Engineer who can confidently lead projects, build credibility with customers and deliver successful outcomes in challenging operational environments.

The ideal candidate will already have experience working within utilities, infrastructure, water, temporary works or pump rental sectors and will be comfortable taking ownership of complex projects involving multiple stakeholders, tight programmes and demanding customer expectations.

Why Join Xylem?

  

·       Deliver high-profile projects for major UK water utilities and Tier 1 contractors.

·       Work on critical infrastructure programmes that support essential public services.

·       Join an industry-leading provider of pumping and water technology solutions.

·       Opportunity to progress into Senior Project Engineer, Project Manager and Programme Management roles.

·       Be part of a business investing heavily in growth across the UK utilities and rental markets.

·       Anglian Water

·       Severn Trent Water

·       Yorkshire Water

·       United Utilities

·       Thames Water

·       Southern Water

·       Major Tier 1 contractors operating across AMP programmes and capital delivery frameworks

This role focuses on designing and managing metagame, live, and progression features to create a satisfying and sustainable mobile experience.
You will own key metagame features from conception through live, coordinating with design, art, UX, engineering, and product management throughout the whole process. As a live game you will need to design features with iteration and extensibility in mind and analyze live data to expand and improve your features over time. We are looking for someone who brings both craft knowledge, an excitement to try new things, and a genuine love of action games.
We embrace a hybrid work environment. Within this role you will work 2 days per week in our London office and the remaining days at home.
What You'll Do: 
Ownership of designing, prototyping, and implementing progression, economy, and engagement features that align with the creative vision of the game
Help define, analyze, and take action on analytics, feature data, and KPIs
Work closely with live and product management teams to define goals and implement solutions to boost engagement
Collaborate closely with art, animation, audio, design and engineering teams to build content and solve problems in a multi-disciplinary environment
Develop and balance in-game economies across many different metagame features
Work closely with UX and engineering to ensure features are implemented in ways that meet the engagement goals
Analyse player data, feedback, and behaviours to identify and fix metagame issues and retention barriers
Work concurrently on multiple features at varying stages of development, managing priorities effectively as content pipelines run in parallel
Document and communicate metagame feature concepts clearly to ensure alignment across all development teams
What You Bring: 
Previous experience in Metagame / Progression / Engagement Design or an equivalent role in the video game industry
At least one shipped title in a design role for a live service title
Experience designing and implementing progression, economy, or engagement features for live gamesKnowledge and experience analyzing KPIs and player behaviour data
Familiarity with the Unreal game engine
Ability to analyse gameplay data and player feedback to inform and balance design decisions
Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively across cross-disciplinary teams
The ability to manage multiple designs in a fast-paced development environment
Passionate about action games with a deep understanding of what makes enemy designs engaging and memorable
Bonus Points: 
Background in mobile games with an understanding of mobile player behaviour and market leaders
Experience with visual scripting or rapid prototyping tools
An avid gamer with a genuine enthusiasm for crafting engaging progression and metagame features and motivating players over a long period of time 
What We Offer You:
Competitive salary and discretionary annual bonus scheme
26 days holiday, plus bank holidays & 2 paid personal days
6 months fully paid maternity/adoption leave and 16 weeks fully paid paternity leave (eligibility criteria applies)
Pension plan, with a double matching employer contribution 
Private medical & dental insurance and healthcare cash plan
Life insurance, personal accident insurance and income protection
Mental health and neurodiversity support programs
Company Employee Stock Purchase Plan (eligibility criteria applies)
Fitness reimbursement plan, worth £600 per annum
Flexible working hours
Weekly happy hours, seasonal parties and monthly social events
Annual rail season ticket advance and cycle to work scheme
